races.race_name: QuinnBet Daily Free Bet Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners.spotlight: 0-12 but she's finished runner-up in her last three hurdle runs including in a Market Rasen handicap (2m7f, good) last month; this drop back in trip is no problem and she has each-way claims back in a maiden.
runners.comment: 0-12 but she's finished runner-up in her last three hurdle runs; in the mix again

runners.name: Fine Thing
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to point and 2m3f/3m hurdle winner Ree Okka; best of four runs in Irish points when runner-up in May, shortly before £20,000 sale; held in third of six when favourite in Market Rasen bumper last month but that was a tactical race and she wasn't beaten far; this step up in trip looks a good move on hurdling debut and she's strongly respected for top yard.
runners.comment: Clear promise in points and she's an interesting contender upped in trip on hurdling debut

runners.name: Cougarontheloose
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to three hurdle/chase winners at up to 2m5f; reached the frame in three Irish points before joining Olly Murphy for £15,000 in May; returns after wind surgery and she needs a close look on rules debut; tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Reached the frame in three Irish points and needs close look on rules debut; had wind op

runners.name: Lipstick Traces
runners.spotlight: 0-10 but she's shown promise over hurdles and was travelling well when she fell three out in a maiden at Market Rasen (2m6f, good) ten days ago; still has potential in this sphere and she's not ruled out back in trip.
runners.comment: Has shown promise over hurdles and was travelling well when she fell at Market Rasen

runners.name: Moonshine River
runners.spotlight: Placed on soft/heavy ground in the last three of her six points, and subsequently changed hands for £10,000; attracted support into 13-2 on hurdling/stable debut at Bangor (2m3f, good) last month and she finished a clear second behind an odds-on rival; has claims if she can build on that and she's a half-sister to a useful hurdler.
runners.comment: Placed in three points and was runner-up on hurdling debut at Bangor; shortlisted

runners.name: Diamond Grace
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Scottish National winner Macdermott; tailed off in a Warwick bumper in April but she made an encouraging start over hurdles when a staying-on third at Worcester (2m, good) last month; should benefit from that run and she's open to progress on this step up in trip; in the mix.
runners.comment: Placed on hurdling debut at Worcester (2m, good) and she's open to progress upped in trip

runners.name: Midnight Pass
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability over hurdles but she's struggled in her last three runs including when pulled up in a handicap at Market Rasen (2m5f, good) last month; overall record is now 0-9 and others are more convincing.
runners.comment: Overall record of 0-9 and she's struggled in last three runs; opposable

runners.name: Orestina
runners.spotlight: 5yo mare who raced in two bumpers at Newcastle for Paul Robson, winning comfortably on AW then well beaten on turf; 66-1 on Flat/stable debut at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month and she finished a remote last of five; has something to prove now switched to hurdling and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Bumper winner but he's struggled in last two starts; something to prove on hurdling debut

runners.name: Miss The Sting
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and she finished tailed off in a Southwell bumper (2m, good) on debut last March; now goes hurdling after a long absence and she can only be watched.
runners.comment: Struggled in a bumper last spring and can only be watched back from a long absence

races.race_name: Jack Frost Chiller & Freezer Hire Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Character Testing
runners.spotlight: 0-17 over hurdles but went close when runner-up at Market Rasen in January and again in a Cartmel seller in May; well below that level on both starts since, including when well held on the Flat 18 days ago; not ruled out if bouncing back.
runners.comment: 0-17 over hurdles but has gone close; below best latest but a revival is possible.

runners.name: Golden Circet
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (1m-1m2f; good or quicker) who returns to hurdles after two fair Flat efforts following wind surgery; took a step forward when a promising fourth on handicap hurdle debut at Plumpton (2m, good to soft) in March and remains capable of better in this sphere; leading contender off a 2lb lower mark.
runners.comment: Three Flat wins; improved as hurdler when 4th on handicap debut and remains of interest.
runners.owner: W Trenchard, A Coupland, Cheam Marketng

runners.name: Granny B
runners.spotlight: Flat winner but 0-18 over hurdles and her thee runs this year have offered little encouragement; easy to look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Flat winner but 0-18 over hurdles; recent runs offer little, others preferred.

runners.name: Lady Fortune
runners.spotlight: Left behind previous efforts when winning at Market Rasen (2m6f, good; hooded) in May after wind surgery, her fourth handicap start, but never figured over 3m there the following month; bought for £3,000 since and, despite the drop in trip not being an obvious plus, she can have a say.
runners.comment: Won at Market Rasen after wind surgery; below that form since; bought for £3,000.

runners.name: Brenda Lady
runners.spotlight: Well held in three maiden/novice hurdles (2m-2m5f); handicap debut offers hope of improvement but she'll need plenty, even with Sean Bowen booked.
runners.comment: Well held in three maiden/novice hurdles; handicap debut may help but plenty needed.

runners.name: Louie The Legend
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner whose best hurdling effort came with the switch to handicaps when third at Southwell (2m, good) in May, but he failed to match that form when well backed at Warwick nine days later; latest Flat run is best overlooked and he has claims if reproducing the Southwell effort.
runners.comment: Dual Flat winner; 3rd on handicap hurdle debut and claims if back to that Southwell form.

runners.name: Daring To Dream
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability in three novice hurdles and didn't run badly when third on handicap debut, albeit beaten 18l; failed to back that up at Taunton the following month but has since had wind surgery; returns from a break with a tongue-tie added and could have more to offer.
runners.comment: Hints of ability over hurdles; below par last time but wind surgery could spark revival.

runners.name: Karthala
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden under all codes but has reached the frame on all three occasions since switched to handicap hurdles; down another 1lb and back in trip, but needs to find more to open his account.
runners.comment: 15-race maiden; has shown promise over hurdles but needs more despite another 1lb drop.

runners.name: Giddyupadingdong
runners.spotlight: 2023 bumper winner but absent a long time before pulling up on hurdle debut in December; showed little in his next three runs after another break until a more encouraging 15l third of 12 at Stratford (2m, good to firm) last month on his second handicap start; still needs better.
runners.comment: 2023 bumper winner; better when third at Stratford last time but needs to build on that.

runners.name: Littletown Lad
runners.spotlight: Has tended to race too freely and has been well held in all three handicap starts despite attracting market support, including after wind surgery; should be capable of better and this is a modest contest but he still needs to learn to settle.
runners.comment: Races freely and well held in three handicaps; can do better, particularly if settling.

runners.name: Colinski
runners.spotlight: Low-grade Flat winner who has shaped with some promise in two completed hurdle starts, most recently when a 14l third at Hexham (2m, good) in June; needs to take a step forward on handicap debut but receives a handy weight-for-age allowance.
runners.comment: Low-grade Flat winner; needs more on handicap hurdle debut but 4yo allowance may help.

runners.name: Battle Stride
runners.spotlight: Failed to build on a mildly encouraging hurdle debut at Stratford (2m, good) in October in two subsequent starts, but heavy ground may not have suited over C&D in December; returns from a break for his handicap debut but needs a marked step forward.
runners.comment: Has failed to build on hurdle debut but may show more now switched to handicaps.

races.race_name: Bravo Benefits Celebrations Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.name: La Pinsonniere
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler who was having her first British start over fences when third of four, beaten 10l, at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last month; her jumping didn't convince that day but maybe returning cheekpieces can help.
runners.comment: Jumping didn't convince over fences last time but maybe returning cheekpieces can help

runners.name: Sunray Shadow
runners.spotlight: Two hurdle wins since May and he squeezed in a successful chase debut at Worcester (2m7f, good) in between; latest third over hurdles here (about 2m7f, good) was a solid effort last Tuesday and he's a firm candidate again; due to go up 1lb.
runners.comment: Respectable third over hurdles here last Tuesday and won chase debut in May; player
runners.owner: S T Racing - The Founders' Syndicate

runners.name: Samuel Spade
runners.spotlight: Five-time winning hurdler who took a firm step forward from May's chasing debut with a convincing win at Worcester (2m7f) the following month; far from discredited when fifth of 13 in valuable event over C&D (again good) and he's a big player in these calmer waters.
runners.comment: Won over fences in May; solid fifth in valuable C&D event last time; big player

runners.name: Sony Bill
runners.spotlight: Showed useful form without winning over hurdles for Willie Mullins; left that yard for 64,000gns having finished fourth over fences at Ballinrobe in May but it was an inauspicious stable debut when tailed off in three-runner affair here (2m4f, good) 17 days ago; needs to leave that behind tackling 3m for the first time.
runners.comment: Inauspicious stable debut when tailed off in three-runner event here (2m4f) 17 days ago

races.race_name: Sun Racing The Favourite Pullout Every Day Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Ip Up
runners.spotlight: Ended a two-year losing run with a strong late surge at Market Rasen (2m, good; last two hurdles omitted) last month in a first-time hood; nudged up only 1lb and likely to be involved again if reproducing that effort.
runners.comment: Ended a long losing run last time and is only 1lb higher; respected if in the same form.

runners.name: Ask A Sainte
runners.spotlight: Readily won over C&D in June on his second start for the stable and, switched to fences, ran well when runner-up off the same mark just eight days later; 7lb higher now but it remains early days for this stable and in handicaps and he could have more to offer.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; good second over fences since and could have more to offer hurdling.

runners.name: Machete Beach
runners.spotlight: Back-to-back hurdle wins in May (2m-extended 2m2f) on good or quicker ground, but was most disappointing when a remote third of three on handicap debut at Stratford last month; that effort was too bad to be true and he's not ruled out if bouncing back.
runners.comment: Back-to-back wins in May; disappointing last time but not ruled out if bouncing back.

runners.name: An Bradan Feasa
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle winner (2m-extended 2m4f); has returned from a break with two solid Flat seconds but disappointed over hurdles at Fakenham in May in between; player if back to his best.
runners.comment: Four-time hurdle winner; solid on the Flat lately and a player if back to his best.

runners.name: King Ulanda
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner who landed a 2m1f chase in May; failed to repeat that form when well held the following month but back over hurdles off a 6lb lower mark and can play a part if back on song.
runners.comment: Lesser chase run since May win; could bounce back off a lower hurdles mark.

runners.name: Romany Brown
runners.spotlight: Killarney maiden hurdle winner (2m1f, good) in May last year who made an encouraging start for this stable when third in a Worcester novice in June, but disappointed on handicap debut following a break and hasn't been seen since a heavy fall in November; returns with something to prove.
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner; absent since a heavy fall in November and has something to prove.
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

races.race_name: Alfie Flatt 18th Birthday Celebration Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Pep Talking
runners.spotlight: Bold-jumping front-runner with seven chase wins, four under Gavin Sheehan; didn't get to the front at Southwell (2m, good) last month and never threatened the winner but shaped as though still in form; remains 7lb higher than for his latest win but could prove hard to catch if allowed an easy lead.
runners.comment: Remains 7lb higher than for latest win but could be hard to catch if allowed an easy lead.

runners.name: Ukantango
runners.spotlight: Has struggled since winning at Southwell (2m4f, good) in April, most recently when a remote last of nine at Worcester in May; needs to turn things around after a short break.
runners.comment: Struggled since April win and needs to turn things around after a short break.

runners.name: Theonlywayiswessex
runners.spotlight: Has returned from a break in good form, building on an encouraging reappearance when adding a third chase win at Warwick (2m4f, good) last month; 8lb higher now and may be vulnerable, but likely to be involved again.
runners.comment: In good form since a break and won at Warwick last month; 8lb higher but respected.

runners.name: Le Gentleman
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; off the mark at the third attempt for the stable when landing a chase at Bangor (2m4f, good) in May and looked set to follow up there the following month until a couple of late mistakes cost him off a 7lb higher mark; up another 2lb but remains open to improvement.
runners.comment: Bangor winner in May and went close off 2lb lower next time; remains open to improvement.
runners.owner: The North West National Hunt Racing Club

runners.name: My Friend Sean
runners.spotlight: Five-time hurdle winner but 0-6 over fences and has been out of form on his last two starts, most recently when a 31l last of five at Southwell (2m, good) in June on his return from a break; that run may have been needed but other candidates appeal more.
runners.comment: Five-time hurdle winner but 0-6 over fences and others arrive with more pressing claims.

races.race_name: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners.spotlight: 1-20 over hurdles; bounced back from heavy 2m defeat (wore visor) with respectable fourth at Cartmel (2m6f, good; no headgear) last month and remains unexposed over this sort of trip but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Last month's Cartmel fourth was respectable but others appeal more all the same

runners.name: Camshaft
runners.spotlight: 2-2 since switched to handicaps and fitted with cheekpieces, the latter win gained from the front at Bangor (2m7f, good) in May; still unexposed over this trip and could still have more improvement to come; big player.
runners.comment: 2-2 since switched to handicaps and still unexposed over this trip; has more to offer

runners.name: Faerie Cutlass
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on old form and will be suited by today's trip/ground but became disappointing last year and made a low-key reappearance in May; revival needed.
runners.comment: Became disappointing last year and made low-key return in May; revival needed

runners.name: Kayla's Friend
runners.spotlight: Displayed improvement to make winning handicap debut here (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month, coming from off the pace; open to significant further progress over this longer trip and commands respect.
runners.comment: Came from off pace to win here (2m4f) on handicap debut; can improve again over new trip

runners.name: Belladinotte
runners.spotlight: Returned from break with win at Southwell (3m, good) in April but did not get competitive when sixth at Hexham (the scene of her other win) last month and, even if back on song, might find others in this line-up better handicapped.
runners.comment: Won in the spring but didn't fire last time and might find others better handicapped here

runners.name: Grey Gamble
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on first two hurdling starts (2m5f/2m3f) but showed some promise at Market Rasen (2m7f, good) last month, keeping on steadily from the rear for never-dangerous fourth; no surprise if she makes further progress in handicaps.
runners.comment: Kept on steadily for fourth in 2m7f maiden last month; can improve again in handicaps

runners.name: Theirshegoes
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in spring 2025 (2m4f/2m5f) but generally disappointing since; moves back up in trip after a quiet 2m run last month; cheekpieces (worn for last four races) are removed; others have much less to prove.
runners.comment: Placed twice in spring 2025 (2m4f/2m5f) but generally disappointing since

runners.name: Athena's Dream
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but placed twice since upped to staying trips this season, more recently when third at Bangor (2m7f, good) 19 days ago; ought to be on the premises again.
runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but placed twice since upped to staying trips this season; in the mix

runners.name: Hello Cello
runners.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when fourth of seven here (2m4f, good) last month but her third off today's mark at Warwick (2m5f, good) two starts ago was a good effort and she's unexposed over this trip; could have a say.
runners.comment: Shade disappointing here last time but has claims if judged on earlier Warwick third
runners.owner: Harry Fry Racing Syndicate Hello Cello

runners.name: Global Hideaway
runners.spotlight: Well beaten over 2m on last month's stable debut, after a layoff, and did not achieve a great deal when last of five finishers (albeit not beaten that far) over 2m5f 12 days ago; not yet exposed after only six starts but needs improvement over this new trip.
runners.comment: Not beaten far at Newton Abbot recently but didn't achieve much; improvement needed

races.race_name: QuinnBet Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Redbarn
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in both Irish points but snapped up for £25,000 in May and made no mistake when winning bumper debut at Worcester (good) last month; uneasy in the market before failing to defy a penalty at Stratford (good to firm) a fortnight ago but she's still a strong candidate.
runners.comment: Won bumper debut last month then second under a penalty; sets the standard

runners.name: Downtown Nashville
runners.spotlight: Similar form on first and third starts in Irish points, latterly when fourth of 11 (3m, good to yielding) in May; has joined a much respected yard and strength in the betting would aid his cause.
runners.comment: Similar form on first and third starts in Irish points; has joined a much respected yard

runners.name: Stand Proud
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros foal by Soldier Of Fortune; fifth foal; half-brother to 2m4f hurdle winner Step Ahead; dam bumper and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle winner, closely related to bumper and 2m/2m3f hurdle winner Elegant Touch, half-sister to bumper, 2m Flat and 2m2f-3m hurdle winner Western Way; trainer has a good record in bumpers and this 4yo hails from a family he knows well; has had wind surgery and tongue-tie already added but needs close market inspection with Harry Cobden booked.
runners.comment: 40,000euros foal; trainer has good record in bumpers; tongue-tie on; likely newcomer

runners.name: Ifyouhaveaplan
runners.spotlight: In the frame on his last two start in points and confirmed he has ability when fifth of 11 at Market Rasen (good) on his bumper debut ten days ago; that form puts him in the mix and he's probably capable of better again.
runners.comment: Confirmed ability when fifth on his bumper debut ten days ago; that puts him in the mix

runners.name: Emerald West
runners.spotlight: £12,000 3yo; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to 2m1f-2m3f chase winner Johnny Og; look for any market clues on this debut.
runners.comment: £12,000 3yo; first foal; look for any market clues on this debut

runners.name: Christine's Star
runners.spotlight: Falco newcomer whose dam was a 1m2f (2yo) and 1m6f winner (RPR 90), half-sister to useful 1m/10.4f Flat and 2m/2m5f hurdle winner All Annalena; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Falco newcomer; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise

runners.name: On The Fly
runners.spotlight: By Free Eagle; fourth foal; half-brother to winners God Knows (1m/10.3f; RPR 79) and Fair Damsel (2m1f hurdle); dam 1m3f/1m4f winner (95), half-sister to 7f-1m winner Korbous, out of prolific 6f-1m winner; stable has only the occasional winner in this sphere; market likely to be a good guide to expectations.
runners.comment: By Free Eagle; stable has only the occasional winner in this sphere; market a good guide

runners.name: Talladale
runners.spotlight: By Passing Glance; first foal; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Isle Of Ewe (2m4f hurdle), Charles De Mille (1m) and Sphere (1m4f), out of 1m4f winning half-sister to Prix Du Cadran winner Invermark; stable no stranger to success in this type of event; heed any market clues.
runners.comment: By Passing Glance; stable no stranger to success in this type of event; heed market clues

runners.name: The Elusive Pike
runners.spotlight: 5,000euros 3yo by Elusive Pimpernel; seventh foal; half-brother to useful 2m hurdle/chase winner Pisgah Pike; dam 2m3f hurdle winner (also placed 1m2f-1m4f Flat; RPR 62), out of French 12.5f winner; yard has a strong record in bumpers; a likely newcomer.
runners.comment: 5,000euros 3yo by Elusive Pimpernel; yard has a strong record in bumpers; considered

runners.name: Pearl Cove
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and beaten 35l on her introduction at Worcester (good) five weeks ago.
runners.comment: 66-1 and beaten 35l on her introduction at Worcester (good) five weeks ago

runners.name: Dreaming Of The Dr
runners.spotlight: Hooded and 10-1 when never a threat at Carlisle (soft) in November; market support would help her enter the picture on this first start since.
runners.comment: Hooded and 10-1 when never a threat at Carlisle (soft) in November

races.race_name: AJA Novice Flat Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (For Riders With 3 Wins Or Fewer At Start Of Season)

runners.name: Cougar
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2025 campaign with a pair of 1m4f wins in Scotland on good to soft/soft; well below par in three comeback outings this spring and sold out of Iain Jardine's yard for £3,500 last month; all turf starts on good or softer; a watching brief is advised.
runners.comment: Out of sorts this spring and best watched now setting out for a new stable

runners.name: Made All
runners.spotlight: Won this race last year on good to soft (also successful over C&D on good to firm); another decent C&D effort when third in a higher grade in May and creditable third over hurdles since; likely to go well.
runners.comment: Good C&D record, including winning this last year; arrives in form again

runners.name: Palazzo Persico
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner for Ed Dunlop; lost his way in Ireland but bounced back to make a winning start for Tony Carroll at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft; fine on faster) last month; possibly found the run coming too soon when only fifth over 1m at Brighton six days later; probably stays 1m4f and retains handicapping scope on his best form.
runners.comment: Made winning start tor Tony Carroll at Chepstow and run possibly came too soon since

runners.name: He's Our Cracker
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces seemed to have a positive effect early in the year, notably for a 1m2f win at Chelmsford under Freddie Robson; has lost his way since (cheekpieces off here) but is back on the mark he defied at Chelmsford so a revival wouldn't surprise in this uncompetitive race.
runners.comment: Lost his way since AW win in March but back on that winning mark and this is uncompetitive

runners.name: On The Bubble
runners.spotlight: Winner under both codes in 2024; creditable second over 1m1f at Musselburgh in April but below that level since, including weakening when stepped back up to around 1m4f last time.
runners.comment: Below par since 1m1f Musselburgh second in April and stamina for 1m4f isn't assured

runners.name: Ruler Of The River
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner but 0-13 on the Flat; didn't offer a great deal in points and a hunter chase for Tom Fife in the spring; others are preferred unless the betting speaks in his favour starting out for Phil Kirby.
runners.comment: Two hurdle wins but 0-13 on Flat; struggled in points and a hunter chase this spring

races.race_name: EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Cheeky Chesca
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 6f Redcar maiden and 5.5f Wetherby novice (both good to firm) at the start of the summer but two lesser runs since need forgiving (well below par latest); cheekpieces now added.
runners.comment: Claims on runner-up efforts at start of summer but well below par latest; cheekpieces on

runners.name: South West
runners.spotlight: Improved effort with blinkers added (retained) when 1l third in 6f Leicester seller (good to firm) 11 days ago; a repeat of that form is likely to see him play a prominent role here.
runners.comment: Improved third in blinkers latest; a repeat of that form should see him go close at least

runners.name: Mick's The Boy
runners.spotlight: Has shown speed on both starts, lasting longer when second to a useful sort at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; the drop to 5f is a help if anything; likely to go well.
runners.comment: Second to a useful sort over 6f latest; look speedy so drop to 5f should suit; player

runners.name: Prosperity Angel
runners.spotlight: £50,000 yearling by Harry Angel and the first foal of a 6f AW 2yo winner (RPR 84); the stable has a useful 2yo to compare her to in last month's ready Hamilton maiden winner Dubai Champion so a market move would be interesting.
runners.comment: Worth second look in betting for yard which had a ready 2yo maiden winner last month

runners.name: Kaiulani Spirit
runners.spotlight: Has hinted at ability on both starts but South West was 2l ahead of him at Leicester latterly.
runners.comment: Has hinted at ability but held by South West on latest Leicester effort

runners.name: Longshanks Luke
runners.spotlight: Second foal of a 5f 2yo winner (RPR 78); wears blinkers on debut; a first ever 2yo runner in Britain for his trainer but worth a betting check starting out in an ordinary event.
runners.comment: Out of a 5f 2yo winner so worth a betting check in a weak race; wears blinkers

runners.name: Lion Of Persia
runners.spotlight: Has good pedigree but hasn't shown much on both starts (remote fourth latterly); early days but he needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Good pedigree but well held both starts; needs to take big step forward

runners.name: Johns Power
runners.spotlight: Beaten around 11l on both 6f starts last month; significant improvement needed.
runners.comment: Beaten around 11l on both 6f starts last month; significant improvement needed

runners.name: Mr De Maggs
runners.spotlight: 80-1 when well held on 6f Carlisle debut last month; needs to have come on a lot.
runners.comment: 80-1 when well held on 6f Carlisle debut last month

runners.name: Neverbeatdeswalker
runners.spotlight: 50-1, weakened to finish a remote last of seven on 6f York debut but he did lead until under 2f out in a race won by last week's July Stakes winner Inner City Blues; this is a much weaker race and he's worth a second look in the betting with the shorter trip also a possible help.
runners.comment: Last on York debut but it was a good race; this is easier and he's worth a look in market

races.race_name: racingtv.com/freetrial Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Lady Dublin
runners.spotlight: Shaped quite well when sixth of 15 in the competitive Rous seller at York (6f, good; form worked out) and perhaps 7f stretched her when only third at short odds in another seller at Musselburgh since; returns to 6f for nursery debut with first-time cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Possibly stretched by 7f latest and shaped well over 6f prior to that; cheekpieces added

runners.name: Showmethebubbles
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability on Beverley debut but has taken two backwards steps since, finishing a distant last of five in Leicester seller (flashed tail) back from wind surgery seven weeks ago; would need to see market support to consider.
runners.comment: Has gone backwards since debut; would need market support to consider

runners.name: Mardy Bum
runners.spotlight: Seems to be getting her act together, finishing off well for third in 5f course nursery (good to firm) last Wednesday; that suggests today's longer trip will suit; gets the vote.
runners.comment: Caught eye with late progress for third in 5f course nursery last week; 6f should suit

runners.name: Sunrise At Dawn
runners.spotlight: Signs of ability in her three qualifying runs at up to 6f (good/good to soft) and won't need to raise her game too much to be very competitive from this opening mark.
runners.comment: Signs of ability in three qualifying runs and won't need to raise her game too much

races.race_name: Le Veinard 2026. Racing And Info Handicap

runners.name: The Good Biscuit
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off this mark on soft ground (also won on good to firm) last autumn; his recent efforts have been no more than respectable but he's nicely handicapped back at venue which suits.
runners.comment: Recent efforts only respectable but C&D winner off this mark last year; not dismissed

runners.name: Aberama Gold
runners.spotlight: Not the force of old but won over C&D (good) off 2lb higher in April and last week's second at Epsom (6f, good to firm) confirms he's back in form; bold show likely.
runners.comment: C&D win off 2lb higher in April and recent Epsom second shows he's back in form; gets vote

runners.name: Two Commanders
runners.spotlight: Confirmed 7f course debut promise when seeing off seven rivals in C&D novice (soft) in June; may have bumped into a useful prospect at Leicester (6f, good to firm) since, pulling well clear of the rest; brings obvious unexposed potential to handicap debut.
runners.comment: C&D novice winner in June who brings obvious unexposed potential to handicap debut

runners.name: Quercus
runners.spotlight: Loves it here, with all but one of his eight wins coming over C&D; however, failed to build on reappearance when well last of six over C&D at the end of May so his hopes are pinned on a change of stable (has left Stephen Hanlon) sparking a return to form.
runners.comment: Seven-time C&D winner but last of six here latest; has changed stable since

runners.name: Kody B
runners.spotlight: Ended 2yo season with soft-ground maiden win over 6f at Pontefract but hasn't reproduced that form in three handicaps this year, including at Chester on Saturday; has first-time cheekpieces added to the tongue-tie he's worn of late.
runners.comment: Maiden winner last autumn failed to make impact in handicaps this year; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Awraad
runners.spotlight: Ran well over 6f in nursery at the York Ebor festival and Listed event at Ripon last August; nowhere near that form in three outings since; a two-month break needs to have had a reviving effect.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two handicaps this spring; two-month break needs to have reviving effect

runners.name: Dream Deal
runners.spotlight: Successful at Beverley (5f, good) last month and ever better efforts when runner-up twice at Pontefract (both 5f, good) since; dual C&D winner last year so no reason why his run of good form won't continue.
runners.comment: Arrives in good form and is a three-time C&D winner so there are reasons to be hopeful

runners.name: Archduke Ferdinand
runners.spotlight: Last two wins have come over 6f at Redcar and he returned to form when third over that C&D (good to firm) in May; well beaten in a big field at York since; first visit to Catterick.
runners.comment: Recent best has been saved for Redcar; well held at York latest; others more obvious

races.race_name: Try Racing TV For Free Now Handicap

runners.name: Haaderr
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on turf on first two starts (including good to firm) before making it third time lucky when comfortably seeing off ten rivals at Southwell (7f, AW) last October; subsequently gelded; this is a slightly belated return to the track but he's potentially useful for in-form Ed Bethell.
runners.comment: Looked promising at 2, culminating with ready AW maiden win; definitely more to come

runners.name: Naval Light
runners.spotlight: Wore down a next-time-out winner (pair clear) late on when making it seventh time lucky in 6f Pontefract maiden (good to soft) under Jack Nicholls eight weeks ago; will be equally as effective back at 7f and can be made to look well treated on a few of his runs.
runners.comment: Came good at Pontefract latest and can be made to look well treated on a few of his runs

runners.name: Woodstock
runners.spotlight: Performed with credit when twice reaching the frame in May; a stumble at the start did not help when only sixth at Thirsk latest but he's winless since 2024 and that wait for a next success may go on unless a change of headgear (first-time visor for regular cheekpieces) gives him a lift.
runners.comment: Some creditable runs this year but no win since 2024 so headgear change needs to work

runners.name: Mudamer
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner from the front last October; mostly creditable efforts in defeat this year and should give it a good shot back at a venue which suits, particularly if he can obtain an uncontested lead.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner last autumn; mostly decent runs in defeat this year; respected back here

races.race_name: Racing Again 22nd July Handicap

runners.name: South Shore
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 for new trainer Robert Cowell when comfortably seeing off eight rivals at Wolverhampton (5f) last week; effectively 7lb higher here but it doesn't look enough to stop him in his current mood.
runners.comment: Ready winner at Wolverhampton last week and can make it 3-3 for new trainer Robert Cowell

runners.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners.spotlight: Third in C&D novice (good to firm) in May but that form has taken several knocks and she's failed to get competitive in two handicaps since.
runners.comment: Form of C&D novice third looks weak and she's failed to get competitive in handicaps since

runners.name: Irish Dancer
runners.spotlight: Gained his fifth success when seeing off ten rivals over C&D (good) in May; only narrowly denied another at Thirsk (5f, good) last month but below par when 3l third of five at Nottingham latest.
runners.comment: Below par third at Nottingham latest but is a dual C&D winner, including in May

runners.name: Invincible Crown
runners.spotlight: Gained a belated first turf success (18th attempt) when getting up on the line at Musselburgh (5f, good) 15 days ago; his record doesn't make him an obvious one to follow up but he should remain competitive off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Finally came good on turf latest and should remain competitive off 4lb higher
runners.owner: Grange Park Racing VIII & Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Lucius Aurelius
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished out of the first three in five starts here, including a win over this trip on good in April; well beaten at Pontefract in first-time blinkers latest but his course record affords him respect with regular cheekpieces also back in place.
runners.comment: Well held at Pontefract latest but has solid Catterick record, including win in April
runners.owner: John Kelly, John McNeill & Kevin Mowatt

runners.name: Zuffolo
runners.spotlight: Back on track with second at Redcar (5f) in April but has finished down the field twice since; bounce back needed.
runners.comment: Second at Redcar in April but down the field twice since; bounce back needed
runners.owner: R R D Saunders And Partner

runners.name: Albegone
runners.spotlight: Latest C&D second on good to firm shows he's in reasonable form; ought to be in the mix again at a course which suits (four wins) but all nine career successes have come on good or softer.
runners.comment: Second over C&D on good to firm latest but all nine wins have come on good or softer
runners.owner: D B & Mrs C Lamplough & Partner

runners.name: Edmond Halley
runners.spotlight: No impact in sprint handicaps in Ireland for Kieran Cotter but did show ability in maidens last autumn and needs checking out in the betting on first start for in-form Ed Bethell; all turf starts in Ireland came on going softer than good.
runners.comment: No impact in handicaps in Ireland but worth a betting check starting out for Ed Bethell

runners.name: Our Absent Friends
runners.spotlight: Respectable third over C&D (good to firm) last month but two lesser Ayr runs have followed, including on Monday.
runners.comment: Fair third over C&D last month but two lesser Ayr runs have followed, including on Monday

races.race_name: Broughton Transport The Mane Logistics Choice Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Saucy Jane
runners.spotlight: Capitalised on a reduced mark to finally post her first handicap win at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; had just a neck to spare but this 3yo has gone back up only 2lb; respected.
runners.comment: Had just a neck to spare when winning at Thirsk but this 3yo has gone back up only 2lb
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 16 And Jmr Partners

runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: He'd been headed when badly hampered at Newbury recently (not recover) but was without his usual visor, in which he was running really well in defeat previously under Chloe Lyons at up to 5.2f; he should be fine at this trip; the visor returns and he could bounce back with a big run.
runners.comment: Headed when badly hampered at Newbury but running really well in defeat previously

runners.name: Grey Horizon
runners.spotlight: Experienced 3yo who was winning for third time this year when scoring at Brighton (6f, good to firm) in May; short-headed at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago by one who was completing a hat-trick; major contender.
runners.comment: Short-headed at Chepstow recently by one who was completing a hat-trick; contender

runners.name: In The City
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who showed promise in maiden/novice races last summer (including here) but has been tailed off on both starts this year (handicap debut last time); a transformation is needed in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; promise last summer but tailed off on both starts this year

runners.name: Reality Queen
runners.spotlight: Won on nursery debut over C&D (good to firm) last September and returned to form to win over C&D (firm) two weeks ago on her second stable start; up 3lb for last time; firmly in calculations kept to her favourite venue.
runners.comment: 3yo who has won twice over C&D, the latest a fortnight ago; firmly in calculations

runners.name: Safari Dream
runners.spotlight: Made all at Salisbury (6f, good) in May; unplaced on next two starts but he was a close fifth of seven at Ffos Las most recently and he ran well over C&D last August on firm ground; might not be far away.
runners.comment: Made all at Salisbury in May; unplaced on both starts since but might not be far away

runners.name: Early Release
runners.spotlight: His form has been up and down this year but he won at Kempton (6f, AW) in March and was back to his best when making all over this C&D (firm) in May; key player if at the top of his game after a 50-day break.
runners.comment: Up and down this year but two wins, the latest over C&D in May; key player if at his best

races.race_name: Resolution Canter Cup EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Bellatina
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two of her four novice/maiden starts and she filled the same position on handicap debut at Catterick last Wednesday (5f, good to firm; led); has her limitations but she's a leading contender in this field.
runners.comment: Runner-up on three of her five starts; has limitations but leading claims in this field

runners.name: Sayidah Ardad
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Brighton (6f, good to firm) in May for Richard Hughes on her second start and a good case can be made on that form; perhaps unsuited by good to soft ground when tailed off on last month's stable debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) but has to leave that performance miles behind.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Brighton on second start but tailed off on stable debut at Chepstow since

runners.name: Tricky Jenny
runners.spotlight: Underwhelming at Lingfield (6f, AW) last month but prior to that she wasn't beaten far when sixth of eight at Ripon (6f, good) in May, showing good speed on that second start; the return to 5f could suit; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Underwhelming last time but showed speed over 6f previously; not ruled out back at 5f

runners.name: Last Dandelion
runners.spotlight: Improved with each of her first three runs, finishing third at Lingfield (6f, AW) on her third outing; not written off but she flopped at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm) last time and it remains to be seen if 5f will suit.
runners.comment: Promising third at Lingfield on her third start but she's flopped at Yarmouth since

runners.name: Sheer Beauty
runners.spotlight: First foal, with dam a 1m AW winner (RPR 82); last month's debut sixth of 13 at 66-1 at Windsor (5f, good to firm) gives her something to build on but she may be one for further down the line.
runners.comment: Last month's debut sixth at 66-1 gives her something to build, but may be one for later on

runners.name: Dissenter
runners.spotlight: Backed into 11-1 from 20-1 for her recent debut here (5.7f, firm) and showed up well for a long way, finishing a close fifth of 11; could show the benefit of that outing today and she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Showed up well for a long way here on debut and could show the benefit of that outing

runners.name: Space Dreamer
runners.spotlight: 14-1, raced freely in front and faded into fifth of ten on debut at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last month; open to improvement and represents an in-form yard; could have a big part to play.
runners.comment: Faded into fifth on debut at Windsor; open to improvement and represents an in-form yard

runners.name: Yankeedoodledandy
runners.spotlight: Tailed off at big odds on both starts (6f, good to firm).
runners.comment: Tailed off at big odds on both starts (6f, good to firm)

races.race_name: Home Group Financial Wealth Management Trophy Handicap (Bath Summer Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Little Miss Magic
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; well beaten here in handicaps in May and June; produced her best effort for over a year when winning going away in a Lingfield classified event (6f, good) latest; well treated on her return to this sphere if repeating that effort but it's hard to predict if she will.
runners.comment: C&D winner; won going away latest; well treated on that form, if she can repeat it.

runners.name: Coast
runners.spotlight: Multiple 6f winner, including on fast ground; losing run now at 31 (placed twice at Brighton this year); not written off but has yet to win over this shorter trip.
runners.comment: Multiple 6f winner; not ruled out but has yet to win over this shorter trip.

runners.name: Beach Partee
runners.spotlight: Two wins over 5f on Polytrack and one at 6f on soft; 6lb lower than when beaten just over 2l here (5.5f, good to firm) in May but hasn't threatened to win for some time.
runners.comment: 6lb lower than when beaten about 2l here in May; hasn't threatened to win for some time.

runners.name: Symbol Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Standing dish here having recorded seven of his eight wins at the track, three over this trip; best of three efforts for this trainer was the first of them here (5.5f, good) last month; it's hard to rule him out here but he needs to be much better than his last two starts.
runners.comment: Course specialist; hard to rule out but needs to be much better than his last two starts.

runners.name: Darkened Edge
runners.spotlight: C&D winner (firm) who was third back over C&D on her reappearance in May and ran to a similar level back here next time; produced a career-best effort when winning a Chepstow classified event (5f, good to firm) latest; needs a similar effort to defy this mark back in a handicap but there are plenty of positives, including with her yard among the winners.
runners.comment: C&D winner; career-best win latest; needs similar to take this but plenty of positives
runners.owner: Mrs N Davies And Chris Mason

runners.name: Secret Handsheikh
runners.spotlight: 5.5f course winner (firm) who arrives on the back of a revived 5f win at Chepstow (good to firm); up 3lb for that but has won several times from higher marks and has to be taken seriously.
runners.comment: Up 3lb for Chepstow win; has won from higher marks and has to be taken seriously.

races.race_name: Novacast Don't Come Last Handicap (Bath Summer Stayers' Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Endofastorm
runners.spotlight: Two-time course winner, the latest last September (1m5f, firm); runner-up here on three of her last five starts, including her latest, and this front-runner can make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Two-time course winner who was runner-up here last time and can make a bold bid

runners.name: Campeona
runners.spotlight: Left her three 2yo runs well behind when upped in trip and runner-up on handicap/seasonal debut here a fortnight ago (11.6f, firm; 11-8 favourite); her inexperience was still evident last time and she should have more to offer for a trainer who won this with 3yos in 2023 and 2024; lots to like.
runners.comment: Runner-up on recent handicap debut here; trainer won this with 3yos in 2023 and 2024

runners.name: Man Of The Sea
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was tailed off over hurdles a fortnight ago but respectable fourth here (2m1f, good) last month and he won twice here last season (1m6f/1m5f, good to firm/firm); could give a good account.
runners.comment: 10yo; tailed off over hurdles recently but two wins here and could give a good account

runners.name: Blue Siam
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden (0-11 on the Flat) who failed to threaten over hurdles last time; however, she ran okay in that code two starts ago and was runner-up on the Flat in February (1m6f, AW); not ruled out each-way in a first-time visor (replacing cheekpieces).
runners.comment: Remains a maiden but some good runs in both codes this year and not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Assured
runners.spotlight: Dropping down the weights but tailed off at big odds on both starts this season and this 5yo is 0-8; major turnaround needed in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Dropping down the weights but tailed off at big odds on both starts this season and is 0-8

races.race_name: Wiltshire And Bath Air Ambulance Charity Handicap

runners.name: Yokkell
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner in this code at up to 1m4f, including on fast ground; usually held up; has had four starts from 1m-1m2f since a break, running reasonably consistently in defeat; drops 2lb and back again in grade; player.
runners.comment: 8.5f-1m4f winner; usually held up; consistent of late; drops 2lb and in grade; player.

runners.name: Man Is King
runners.spotlight: Triple course winner over 1m-1m2f, including on firm; placed elsewhere over 1m4f; 1lb higher than when winning a 0-60 here last month; claims if repeating that effort but has a bit to prove after his last three starts.
runners.comment: Claims if repeating last month's winning effort but bit to prove after last three starts.

runners.name: Offiah's Boy
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner on fast ground, including when 2lb higher last August; backed that up with success from 5lb higher at Salisbury (1m2f) next time but has been nowhere near that level since; well beaten here latest and plenty to prove at present.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner including from a higher mark, but well below par lately; plenty to prove.

runners.name: Cezarro
runners.spotlight: 0-15 and placed just once (1m2f, good to firm); well beaten in a selling handicap (1m4f, AW) on first start for this yard and it's hard to make a strong case for him.
runners.comment: 0-15; well beaten in a selling handicap on debut for this trainer; hard to make a case.

runners.name: Jimmy Mark
runners.spotlight: Triple course winner, including on firm and over this trip; placed over 1m2f here on his reappearance, when 1lb higher in May; probably too free at Windsor (11.5f, good to firm) latest but will be an each-way player if able to settle better.
runners.comment: Triple course winner; too free at Windsor latest but an each-way player if settling.

runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner at around 1m4f (turf and AW); 3lb lower than her latest success, in February; well below par on her last four starts, including over C&D latest; revival needed dropping in grade.
runners.comment: Below par on her last four starts, including C&D latest; revival needed dropping in grade.

runners.name: Bug Boy
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who hasn't scored since August 2023; well beaten in his only two starts since September 2024 and looks best watched.
runners.comment: Well beaten in his only two starts since September 2024 and looks best watched.

runners.name: Hope Rising
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in seven Flat starts (last ran in this sphere in 2024); triple good-ground hurdle winner at up to 2m1f last summer; reluctant to race when well beaten over hurdles latest; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 0-7 on Flat before three hurdle wins last summer; reluctant to race over hurdles latest

races.race_name: Stakes Are Always High Handicap

runners.name: Havana Club
runners.spotlight: Went down by only a head over C&D (firm) in April; things didn't go his way (slightly hampered) when fourth of 11 at Windsor (1m, good to firm) 16 days ago; likely to go well.
runners.comment: Solid C&D record and latest Windsor fourth creditable; a prominent showing is likely

runners.name: Thai Princess
runners.spotlight: The sole 3yo in the line-up; never posed a serious threat back from wind surgery when fifth of seven on 7f Chepstow handicap and turf debut (good to firm) 18 days ago but still early days for a top stable and she shapes as if the step up to 1m could suit.
runners.comment: Only fifth on 7f handicap debut but this filly from top yard shapes as if 1m could suit

runners.name: Mbappe
runners.spotlight: Ended a losing sequence at Kempton (1m) in January but held off higher marks twice since, albeit his latest run may have been needed after a break.
runners.comment: Below par since 1m Kempton win in January, although may have needed latest run after break

runners.name: Rival
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2022 and nothing like as good now; failed to build significantly on reappearance when sixth of ten over 1m at Chepstow (good) last month and the losing run seems likely to continue
runners.comment: Winless since 2022 and that isn't likely to end soon based on two efforts this year

runners.name: Blue Hero
runners.spotlight: All ten wins achieved here, dropping to classified company to get his head back in front over this trip (firm) a fortnight ago; part of a strong hand in this finale for Adrian Wintle.
runners.comment: Tenth course success when leading late in classified event latest; should figure again

runners.name: My Ambition
runners.spotlight: Won this race off 3lb higher in 2024; back in form when placed twice this spring but not so good on last two starts; needs a return to Bath to spark a revival.
runners.comment: Won this race in 2024; not at best last twice so needs return to Bath to spark revival

runners.name: Weston Court
runners.spotlight: Has largely struggled since landing two wins (including C&D on firm) in the summer of 2024 but did take a step back in the right direction when second of five at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) last Wednesday; claims if he can back that up.
runners.comment: C&D winner in 2024; one of better efforts since when second over 7f at Chepstow last week

runners.name: Whisper Of Mist
runners.spotlight: No show in three qualifying runs (including C&D) but a low-grade handicap does provide her with a more realistic chance.
runners.comment: No show in three qualifying runs but more chance now in a low-grade handicap

races.race_name: O'Donoghue Ring Collection Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Minaun View
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when winning a Bellewstown claimer over this trip last time; there is more depth to this race but is likely to be involved again.
runners.comment: Won a Bellewstown claimer last time; there is more depth to this but can be involved again

runners.name: Land Of The Giants
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; won a 1m1f Ayr handicap in May and some decent runs in defeat since including in a Bellewstown claimer behind stablemate Minaun View last time; similar terms today so can be involved.
runners.comment: Third in a Bellewstown claimer behind stablemate Minaun View last time;  can be involved

runners.name: Seti One
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; was fourth in a 1m2f Curragh maiden for Willie McCreery last year but form deteriorated after; no better on debut for this yard; blinkers need to work.
runners.comment: Fourth in a 1m2f maiden last year but form deteriorated after and blinkers need to work

runners.name: Timandi
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when easily winning a Tramore claimer over 1m4f last time; has run well at this track before but likely to find this trip on the sharp side.
runners.comment: Won a Tramore claimer over 1m4f last time; likely to find this trip on the sharp side
runners.owner: Mrs N K Griffin & T Brosnan

runners.name: Elman
runners.spotlight: Showed a hint of ability in Flat maidens for Johnny Murtagh last year; didn't take to hurdling for this yard and recent Flat efforts have been poor; looks flattered by a rating of 68.
runners.comment: Recent Flat efforts have been poor and looks flattered by a rating of 68

runners.name: Cosmic Funk
runners.spotlight: Some promise in maidens before second (btn 5l) on handicap debut at Leopardstown; found to be coughing post-race after a lesser run there since; in-form yard does well in these events and has a shout on these terms.
runners.comment: Coughing after Leopardstown last time; in-form yard does well in these events; a shout

runners.name: Glamazon
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark in a 1m1f Ballinrobe maiden in May; best run since was fourth in a Bellewstown handicap last time; the blinkers worn then are retained but she needs to do more on these terms.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over 1m1f; fourth in 1m h'cap last time; needs to do more on these terms

runners.name: Love Orchid
runners.spotlight: Was progressive in maidens last year without winning; has been regressive in handicaps this term; the blinkers worn last time retained; needs more.
runners.comment: Regressive in handicaps this term; the blinkers worn last time retained; needs more

runners.name: Aurora Mist
runners.spotlight: Improved from her seasonal debut to get off the mark in a Gowran handicap over this trip last time; is taking on older horses now on unfavourable terms but is in form so that counts in this grade.
runners.comment: Won a Gowran handicap over this trip last time and is in form so that counts in this grade

runners.name: Hazrama
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Naas last year but beaten a long way over 6f at the Curragh on return; needs to improve hugely on that form.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way over 6f at the Curragh on return; needs to improve hugely on that form
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Darkdeserthighway
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner but just 1-23 on turf; well beaten at Bellewstown on return last time and will have to improve loads to win on these terms.
runners.comment: Well beaten at Bellewstown last time and will have to improve loads to win on these terms

runners.name: Go Out
runners.spotlight: Maiden has shown his best form on the AW; some decent turf runs this term but will have to improve a fair bit on last two efforts to win on these terms.
runners.comment: Will have to improve a fair bit on last two efforts to win on these terms
runners.owner: Mrs John Murphy & John Pearson & Karl Kirwan

runners.name: Magna Kotcha
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; some promise on debut at Naas but well below that twice since, all on soft ground; has to do much better now tackling faster ground.
runners.comment: Promise on debut but well below that twice since, all on soft; has to do much better

runners.name: Usuario Amigo
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a Brighton maiden in September 2024; has been regressive over various trips this season including when ninth in a 1m handicap here yesterday; others preferred.
runners.comment: Regressive over various trips this season, including here yesterday; others preferred

races.race_name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: South Dakota
runners.spotlight: Ran green on debut when fourth over 6f at the Curragh (form franked since); improved on that when a close fourth in the Chesham Stakes at Royal Ascot; should take beating with a repeat of that form.
runners.comment: Fourth in the Chesham Stakes at Royal Ascot; should take beating with a repeat of that run
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Celtic Moon
runners.spotlight: Improved nicely from her Leopardstown debut on soft to win a Bellewstown maiden over this trip on good ground; this is a step up in grade but she gets weight from all her rivals and has to be considered.
runners.comment: Won a Bellewstown maiden over this trip; gets weight from all her rivals so  considered

runners.name: Pints Of Glory
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to winners incl' Across The Nile (1m/8.6f AW; RPR 78) and Feel Good Factor (7f AW; 71); dam Listed-placed 7f winner (inc 2yo; 99); cost Eur32,000 as a foal; related to winners and gets weight from most of today's rivals so can run well.
runners.comment: Related to winners and gets weight from most of today's rivals so can run well

runners.name: Dakota Jack
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Elysium (7f 2yo Group 3), Elite Legion (7f 2yo) and Muntahez (1m1f), out of Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner; Eur30,000 foal made Eur62,000 as a yearling; by a quality sire and a solid damline; could go well on debut.
runners.comment: Cost Eur62,000 as a yearling; by a quality sire and a solid damline; could go well

runners.name: Full Volume
runners.spotlight: Improved nicely from his 7f debut at Down Royal to score in clear-cut fashion at Bellewstown over this trip; needs to take another step forward in this company but a solid effort is likely again.
runners.comment: Won at Bellewstown over this trip; needs to take another step forward in this company

runners.name: Venetian Power
runners.spotlight: Nicely-bred sort ran with credit on debut in what looked a strong Curragh 7f maiden; should have taken a step forward since and likely to be more competitive.
runners.comment: Fourth in a Curragh 7f maiden; should have taken a step forward and be more competitive

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden

runners.name: Transcript
runners.spotlight: Tremendous pedigree but was already gelded when making his debut in a Naas maiden over this trip; ran a cracker to finish ahead of several of today's rivals and, with improvement to come, should take a bit of beating today.
runners.comment: Ahead of several of today's rivals on debut and should take a bit of beating today
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Kalir
runners.spotlight: Best effort in five maidens came when fourth at Naas over this trip last time, first start since being gelded; has less than 1l to make up on Transcript from that run so there shouldn't be much between them today.
runners.comment: Less than 1l to make up on Transcript from last run so shouldn't be much between them
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Elusive Path
runners.spotlight: Started at 50/1 but was a solid third on debut at Fairyhouse; battled on well when a close second at Limerick since; both those runs were over 7f but is bred to stay this trip and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Solid runs both starts over 7f; bred to stay this trip and is one to consider

runners.name: Cello Sonata
runners.spotlight: Cost Eur50,000 at a breeze-up sale; started 28/1 but ran a solid race in a Naas maiden over this trip on debut; was 2.5l behind Transcript that day and has a bit of work to do to turn that form around.
runners.comment: Solid debut run at Naas; 2.5l behind Transcript that day and has a bit of work to do to

runners.name: Holy Lettuce
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to 1m winner Electric Lightning (RPR 65); dam 6f turf 2yo/7f AW winner (91), out of maiden half-sister to a pair of useful winners; Eur10,000 vendor buy-back as a foal; can improve from this debut.
runners.comment: Eur10,000 vendor buy-back as a foal; can improve from this debut

runners.name: Pinoroyale
runners.spotlight: Cost Eur75,000 as a yearling and closely related to a Listed winner; only beaten 7l on debut in a Naas maiden over this trip; can improve from that but has 6.5l to make up on Transcript.
runners.comment: Beaten 7l on debut in a Naas maiden over this trip; can be more competitive today

runners.name: Private Peaceful
runners.spotlight: Seventh foal; half-brother to winner in Serbia; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 73), half-sister to Italian Listed-placed 5f/6f winner Eva Kant, out of half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Fashionable; Eur5,500 yearling is best watched for future reference on debut.
runners.comment: Eur5,500 yearling is best watched for future reference on debut

runners.name: Winston's Promise
runners.spotlight: Beaten 15l in a Limerick maiden on debut; can improve for that but best watched for now.
runners.comment: Beaten 15l in a Limerick maiden on debut; can improve for that but best watched for now

runners.name: Omissions
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in both maiden runs and is best watched with handicaps in mind.
runners.comment: Well beaten in both maiden runs and is best watched with handicaps in mind

runners.name: Strikewhileitshot
runners.spotlight: Decent efforts on first two maiden runs last year for Jessica Harrington but a lesser run when last seen; needs improvement on return/yard debut.
runners.comment: Some promise on first two runs last year; needs improvement on return/yard debut

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cairn Rouge Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Green Carrera
runners.spotlight: A big improver this season, winning a valuable Curragh handicap before taking the very competitive Sandringham handicap at Royal Ascot, both over a mile; looks the stable first-string today and can be a big player.
runners.comment: Won the Sandringham h'cap at Royal Ascot; looks the stable first-string today; big player

runners.name: Drop Dead Gorgeous
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut over this trip at Naas and was a close third in a Curragh Group 3 after; was beaten by more than the 1m2f trip there next time and was again below her best at Navan since; has a shout if the tongue-tie and cheekpieces work; looks stable's first-string.
runners.comment: Below her best last twice but has a shout if the tongue-tie and cheekpieces work
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Pivotal Attack
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Galway maiden in fine style last year and has run well in defeat in Group company three times since over that trip; well beaten in the Irish 1000 Guineas last time; the top-rated in this field but needs to prove she stays a mile.
runners.comment: Has run well in Group races over this trip; top-rated but needs to prove she stays a mile

runners.name: Meriden
runners.spotlight: Rapid improver has notched a four-timer between 6.5f and 7f, culminating in a 3l win in a Curragh fillies' premier handicap; has improved 40lb in the weights in that time, is ground-versatile so has to be respected; the trip is a question but promises to stay.
runners.comment: Has improved 40lb in her four h'cap wins; this trip is a question but promises to stay
runners.owner: Patrick John O'Brien & Mrs Paul Shanahan

runners.name: Spinning Around
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Dundalk nursery last October and gained another win over the same trip in a Curragh fillies' handicap in May; respectable run in the Sandringham H'cap at Royal Ascot, first in her far side ground; has a bit to find still.
runners.comment: Solid run in the Sandringham H'cap at Royal Ascot but has a bit to find still
runners.owner: Mrs M V Magnier,Mrs O'Loughlin,Mrs Byrne

runners.name: Sky Watch
runners.spotlight: Won an AW maiden over this trip last November; improved efforts this term in a Curragh Group 3 and the German 1000 Guineas; cheekpieces are added and doesn't have much to find with the best of these so can be a player.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces are added and doesn't have much to find with the best of these so a player

runners.name: Cromac Quay
runners.spotlight: Built on her first two maiden efforts over this trip when running away with a 7f Leopardstown maiden last time; the ground was soft that day so different conditions today but has a shout if handling them.
runners.comment: Ran away with a 7f Leopardstown maiden last time on soft; a shout if handling conditions

runners.name: Sinmara
runners.spotlight: Was a wide-margin winner of a Gowran maiden in April before a solid fourth in a Curragh Group 3; beaten 10l by Precise in the Irish 1000 Guineas since; this is calmer waters and can run well but looks the stable second-string.
runners.comment: This is easier than last time and can run well but looks the stable second-string

runners.name: Quiet Mutiny
runners.spotlight: Beat the mighty Precise in a Fairyhouse 6f maiden on debut last year; missed the rest of last year and the best of three runs this term was a close fourth in a Curragh handicap; has 12l to make up on Green Carrera from the Sandringham h'cap; new yard.
runners.comment: Has 12l to make up on Green Carrera from the Sandringham h'cap last time; new yard

runners.name: Wild Bessie
runners.spotlight: Promise on AW debut last year and showed major improvement to take a Cork maiden on return (7f; sft/hvy); found Group 3 company at the Curragh too tough since and has a bit to find today.
runners.comment: Found Group 3 company at the Curragh too tough last time and has a bit to find today

runners.name: Donna Time
runners.spotlight: Best run when beaten 5l in a Naas maiden over this trip last time; however, this is highly ambitious and has loads to find in this grade.
runners.comment: This is highly ambitious for a maiden and has loads to find in this grade

runners.name: White Sand Beach
runners.spotlight: Placed several times in maidens up to this trip including in first-time blinkers at Naas last month; well-held in Listed company the time before; has plenty to find; due to run in the 7.30 here on Monday.
runners.comment: Second at Naas last month; well-held in Listed company the time before; has plenty to find
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

races.race_name: Executive Helicopters Handicap

runners.name: Tortola
runners.spotlight: Maiden reappeared early this month with best run yet in handicaps on yard debut, coming from some way back to finish second at Bellewstown over this trip (good); can go well now from a good draw.
runners.comment: Improvement on yard debut at Bellewstown; can go well now from a good draw

runners.name: Liamo
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Listowel last summer (off 40); comeback run there in late May should have him straighter but others look more likely.
runners.comment: Listowel comeback run should have him straighter but others look more likely

runners.name: Draiocht
runners.spotlight: Breakthrough win came over C&D last October (soft); hooded for somewhat belated seasonal debut here and may just need it.
runners.comment: C&D win last October came on soft; belated seasonal debut and may just need it

runners.name: The Blue Panther
runners.spotlight: Five career wins, last two coming at Listowel; first sign of form this season on latest when never nearer fourth at Roscommon 15 days ago; down to a decent mark so considered.
runners.comment: Recent Roscommon fourth signalled a return to form; decent mark
runners.owner: Ms Julianne McNally & Colette McNally & D McNally

runners.name: Bella Colombia
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been on the AW, including in March off 59; close third from a bad draw at Dundalk on Sunday, having 11 days earlier chased home Pete's Dream at Fairyhouse over this trip; has her chance again and good draw plus 5lb claimer booked.
runners.comment: Dundalk third on Sunday holding her form well; has her chance again and good draw

runners.name: Jasmine Affanalis
runners.spotlight: Tipperary winner last summer was only just denied over C&D in May; first-time cheekpieces had no positive effect at Fairyhouse on latest and now discarded.
runners.comment: Just denied over C&D in May off 1lb lower; cheekpieces tried latest now ditched

runners.name: Pete's Dream
runners.spotlight: Belated first win came at Fairyhouse early this month when beating Bella Colombia over this trip on good ground under today's rider; reportedly returned with blood in nostrils but can't be ruled out here off 5lb higher.
runners.comment: Fairyhouse win over Bella Colombia; 5lb higher now but respected

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Two Flat wins came in 2024; recent Fairyhouse run leaves him with a good bit to find but previous Leopardstown third was a solid run; visor tried now, replacing tongue-tie/cheekpieces; interesting jockey booking.
runners.comment: Penultimate Leopardstown run was decent; visor now replaces tongue-tie/cheekpieces

runners.name: Medieval Night
runners.spotlight: Maiden's best efforts have come in Leopardstown handicaps, including six days ago when staying on fourth (having hung left) off today's mark; not one to rule out but others with stronger claims.
runners.comment: Recent Leopardstown fourth not one to rule out but others with stronger claims

runners.name: Shahada Ace
runners.spotlight: Won at Tipperary last summer but yet to make an impact in five outings this season.
runners.comment: Won at Tipperary last summer but yet to make an impact in five outings this season

runners.name: Convincing
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose better efforts have come in C&D maidens; both recent handicap runs have been on heavy ground, 1m2f possibly too far at Navan latest; handicapper relenting so not without a chance back on better ground and yard going well.
runners.comment: Maiden form here; potential improver back on better ground

runners.name: James Henry
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner is now 0-16 on turf; encouraging yard debut at Listowel in late May and met trouble in running at Limerick; tongue-tie now tried but wide draw not ideal.
runners.comment: Now 0-16 on turf; tongue-tie now tried but wide draw not ideal

runners.name: Secret Magician
runners.spotlight: Last turf win came at Naas nearly two years ago (off 63); standout run this term when C&D third (neck off second-placed Jasmine Affanalis) in May, most recently didn't seem to get home at Bellewstown; Colin Keane booking takes the eye.
runners.comment: C&D third in May puts him in the mix; Colin Keane booking takes the eye

races.race_name: Start Your Free Month Trial At racingtv.com Handicap

runners.name: Alto Sax
runners.spotlight: Winner this year over shorter at Dundalk and Fairyhouse and better again over 1m1f at Leopardstown six days ago when beaten a neck off this mark in 22-runner contest, having had every chance; not at best on only previous attempt at this longer trip so bit to prove.
runners.comment: Just denied at Leopardstown 6 days ago; this trip could stretch him though

runners.name: Vervain
runners.spotlight: Winner over this trip on good ground at Cork last summer for Joe Murphy; tongue-tied on recent yard debut when staying on late into fourth (third has won since) at Tramore, having not handled track; potential improver.
runners.comment: Yard debut promise at Tramore recently; potential improver

runners.name: Tassarolo
runners.spotlight: Last year's win in this race came off 1lb lower (soft); winning hurdler has been running okay on the Flat of late but good bit more needed and draw hasn't been kind.
runners.comment: Last year's winner needs to improve markedly on recent form and draw hasn't been kind

runners.name: Limestone Red
runners.spotlight: Has won twice on AW; most recent success in January; 0-15 on turf; however, two runs this term not without promise but plenty more needed; tries a new trip.
runners.comment: Two runs this term not without promise but plenty more needed; tries a new trip

runners.name: Arch Enemy
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose mare was gaining her first Flat win in nearly two years when getting up late over 1m2f at Navan on Saturday (first two clear); quick return under mandatory 7lb penalty (upped 10lb in future) and longer trip in her favour.
runners.comment: Got up late at Navan on Saturday; quick return under 7lb penalty and longer trip to suit

runners.name: Limbocall
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo showed some promise in maidens last summer but opening two handicap efforts poor; entitled to come on for last month's comeback run and Colin Keane now booked; 6lb lower but not bred for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Better for recent comeback run; Keane booked but suspect stayer on breeding

runners.name: Highway Sixty One
runners.spotlight: Low-grade maiden has posted solid runs in three starts this year, most recently chasing home a 10l winner over this trip at Tramore eight days ago (third has won since, Vervain fourth); should be in the mix and good draw.
runners.comment: Recent Tramore second should be in the mix again and good draw

runners.name: Kevin The Great
runners.spotlight: Improved effort on debut for this yard at Navan (1m5f, good) last month when a staying on fourth over 1m5f (good); badly away and didn't handle track at Bellewstown latest so that run forgiven.
runners.comment: Didn't handle track at Bellewstown, prospects on previous Navan fourth

runners.name: Crypto Crash
runners.spotlight: Best effort when second over 1m4f on fast ground for David Marnane in 2024; moderate hurdles form and faded tamely in straight (hung left) on Flat return at Leopardstown last month; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Faded tamely in straight (hung left) on Flat return at Leopardstown; hard to fancy

runners.name: Monroe Dasher
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo never sighted on last month's Limerick comeback run (1m); big step up in trip and best watched unless market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Big step up in trip and best watched unless market speaks in his favour

runners.name: Young Churchill
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler for Noel Meade; regressive on Flat in recent years until much more encouraging run at Limerick on Saturday, coming from some way back under 7lb claimer when beaten a head/neck over 1m4f (good); Billy Lee now takes over and major claims off same mark but draw a negative.
runners.comment: Saturday's Limerick run makes him a big player but wide draw a possible negative

runners.name: Voice Of Northeast
runners.spotlight: Maiden whose best run for this yard was on seasonal return at Leopardstown when good fourth (1m5f, good); didn't seem to stay longer trip at Bellewstown so should appreciate drop back in distance here.
runners.comment: Didn't seem to stay longer trip at Bellewstown so should appreciate drop back in distance

runners.name: Deuteronomy
runners.spotlight: Gained fourth career win with 22-1 success at Cork in May in testing conditions; not so good since on faster ground, although fair effort at Navan on Saturday behind Arch Enemy; tries a longer trip here.
runners.comment: Fair effort at Navan on Saturday behind Arch Enemy; tries longer trip but wants it softer

runners.name: Fantasy Fara
runners.spotlight: Yet to have an impact in handicaps this year, loads to find with some of these on most recent Tramore run.
runners.comment: Yet to have an impact in handicaps, loads to find with some of these on Tramore run

runners.name: God Of Thunder
runners.spotlight: Has done plenty of racing since a Limerick win last summer; generally modest form this season, with the exception of a Navan third; others look more likely.
runners.comment: Generally modest form this season, others look more likely

races.race_name: Kitty O'Se's Seafood And Grill Restaurant Handicap

runners.name: Lagoon Nebula
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-13 on the Flat but several good placings at up to 2m including last month at Ballinrobe when chasing home a ready winner (won again since) over 1m5f; can go well.
runners.comment: Recent Ballinrobe second can go well off same mark

runners.name: Lauderdale King
runners.spotlight: Good opening efforts in handicaps, staying on late over 1m2f at Cork and raced handier over slightly shorter at Gowran, weakening late on when only beaten 1l into fourth; upped in trip now and contender if he stays.
runners.comment: Good opening efforts in 1m2f handicaps; upped in trip now and contender if he stays

runners.name: Coulstys Way
runners.spotlight: In good form last summer, winning at Roscommon (1m4f, good) and placed on four occasions; should be better for last month's return at Fairyhouse and yard in fine form of late.
runners.comment: Better for last month's return at Fairyhouse and yard in fine form of late

runners.name: Celestially
runners.spotlight: Much the best of three handicap efforts came on latest when only denied second late on over this trip at Bellewstown (good); bit to find with second-placed Jurality on that form but 3yo looks on the improve and more possible (1lb wrong).
runners.comment: Bellewstown third; 3yo looks on the improve and more possible

runners.name: Baila Conmigo
runners.spotlight: Trio of Dundalk AW wins this year, including on returning from a short break on Sunday over 1m4f, holding on well after being sent on some way out by today's rider (who is now able to use his claim) in apprentice contest; 0-8 on turf but has to be respected under mandatory 7lb penalty (up 5lb in future).
