runners.comment: AW winner on Sunday; 0-8 on turf but respected under mandatory 7lb penalty

runners.name: Jurality
runners.spotlight: Gained reward for a string of solid efforts when winning at Navan (1m5f, good) last month and only narrowly failed to follow up at Bellewstown five days later, getting caught on the line over 1m7f after forcing it; up a total of 12lb for those efforts so more needed.
runners.comment: In fine form of late at around this trip on good; up a total of 12lb but still respected

runners.name: Loyal Touch
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner in Britain at up to 1m2f (rating peaked at 93); not at the same level for this yard, including over hurdles; handicapper giving him every chance but others preferred.
runners.comment: Five-time winner in Britain at up to 1m2f; not at the same level for this yard

runners.name: Moyassr
runners.spotlight: Boasts a fine AW record (four wins) and gained a first turf victory at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) in May off 60; soft ground may have been his undoing at Leopardstown following month so respected here back on a sound surface although this much longer trip an unknown.
runners.comment: 1m2f is the furthest he's won over so trip an unknown; ground to suit

runners.name: Parish Express
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo threw away her chance when running wide on turn on handicap debut (apprentice) at Roscommon in May; senior rider takes over.
runners.comment: Hung badly on handicap debut at Roscommon for an apprentice; senior rider takes over

runners.name: Party Dress
runners.spotlight: Two wins, latest win coming over 2m1f (good) at Limerick last June off this mark; respectable return to the Flat at the Curragh last month but good bit more needed.
runners.comment: Respectable return to the Flat at the Curragh last month but good bit more needed

runners.name: Folly Beach
runners.spotlight: Three years since her sole Flat win (1m7f, soft) but only narrowly denied over 1m5f at Down Royal last month on similar ground; not as effective on fast ground six days later at the Curragh so ground concerns again here.
runners.comment: Best form on soft so obvious ground concerns here

runners.name: Devine Genius
runners.spotlight: Best run for Adrian Murray came when placed in Tipperary 2yo maiden (soft); very light campaign in recent years, soundly beaten over 1m4f at Curragh and Tramore this term; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten over 1m4f at Curragh and Tramore this term; hard to fancy

runners.name: Maarisha
runners.spotlight: Placed in Naas fillies maiden last summer but didn't progress, well held on handicap debut final start last October for Willie Browne; upped in trip for seasonal/yard debut and watching brief advised.
runners.comment: Maiden upped in trip for seasonal/yard debut and watching brief advised

runners.name: Sonic Invader
runners.spotlight: Appreciated step up to 1m6f at Gowran (good to yielding) for his second handicap start when keeping on for third in May; 2m may have stretched his stamina at Listowel following month; one to consider back to this trip.
runners.comment: 2m may have been beyond him at Listowel; one to consider back to this trip

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Golden Orbit
runners.spotlight: Newmarket maiden winner on her sole start last term for whom there were high hopes this year; proved underwhelming when favourite for an Oaks trial at Newbury on her reappearance and was tried in blinkers when tailed off in the Group 2 Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot; now tries cheekpieces on her handicap debut and it's too soon to write her off.
runners.comment: One-time Classic hope; makes handicap debut and it is too soon to write her off
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Probation
runners.spotlight: Consistent form in three qualifying races, including when third of eight here (1m2f, soft; acts on quicker) last month; goes up in trip for his handicap debut and looks the solid option.
runners.comment: Consistent in three qualifying runs; up in trip for handicap debut; the solid option

runners.name: Rajendra
runners.spotlight: Best of three previous runs came when fourth of 11 in 1m Southwell maiden (AW; first-time hood) in January but he was 28-1 and beaten 23l when finishing last here (1m1f, soft) on his handicap debut last month; still fairly early days but this new trip will need to spark plenty of improvement.
runners.comment: Will need to do much better than when beaten 23l on his handicap debut last month

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Lunella
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to four winners, notably Stratum (1m2f-2m5f Flat, RPR 115; useful 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase), who was hooded when finishing third of three on her debut in warm Windsor novice (1m2f, good to firm) 18 days ago; threatened to get in a bid before weakening that day and she's a candidate to step forward going up in trip on this second start; hood removed.
runners.comment: Wore a hood (now removed) when promising third on debut; up in trip; leading candidate

runners.name: Brunhilde
runners.spotlight: Confirmed she has ability when upped to this sort of trip and chasing home a high-profile filly at Doncaster (good to firm) 19 days ago; looked to need every yard of that test so maybe first-time cheekpieces can sharpen her up a touch; key player.
runners.comment: Confirmed ability when 2nd over this sort of trip latest; gets cheekpieces; key player

runners.name: Silk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Wasn't disgraced on his bumper debut here (2m, AW) in December but two lesser efforts in that sphere have followed; switches codes with something to prove.
runners.comment: Didn't build on initial promise in bumpers; switches codes with something to prove

runners.name: Battle Hymn
runners.spotlight: Proved strong in the market but let his fans down when fourth of six at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) in March; contrastingly friendless in the betting on his turf debut at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) in May and he finished tailed off; goes up in trip and has been gelded so worth a market check.
runners.comment: Well backed before disappointing on debut; tailed off on turf last time; has been gelded

races.race_name: Hamways EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Fire Thunder
runners.spotlight: Looked a shade unfortunate when runner-up on her first two starts but no excuses when collared by an unheralded outsider here (6f, AW; acts on turf) six weeks ago; doesn't look to be doing anything wrong in a finish and she sets a clear standard among those to have raced.
runners.comment: Runner-up all three starts; sets the standard and today can be her day

runners.name: Mrs Mole
runners.spotlight: She offered something to work on when fourth of ten at Leicester (good) on her debut in June but it was a backward step when well held at Carlisle (also 7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; drops in trip and not without a chance if tapping back into that initial promise.
runners.comment: Fairly encouraging debut not backed up latest; drops in trip and not without a chance

runners.name: Mystic Ballistic
runners.spotlight: 3,000gns yearling by Lope Y Fernandez; third foal; half-sister to 1m winner Ballymagreehan (including AW; RPR 67); dam placed 7f AW (66), half-sister to useful 5.7f/6f winner Show Stealer; hooded filly who is the first juvenile runner of the year for her yard.
runners.comment: 3,000gns yearling by Lope Y Fernandez; hooded; first 2yo runner of the year for her yard

runners.name: Langdale Lass
runners.spotlight: By Tasleet; half-sister to winners Hackness Harry (6f AW 2yo; RPR 71) and Fulford Cross (7f AW; 65) for these connections; dam finished fourth (5f) on her only start (2yo, 56), sister to useful 5f/6f winner Primrose Valley, out of multiple 5f winner; market helpful on this introduction.
runners.comment: By Tasleet from a family these connections know well; market helpful on this introduction

runners.name: Nightspell
runners.spotlight: 12,000gns foal by Kameko whose price dropped to 1,800gns as a yearling; third foal; half-sister to 2m winner Rogue Empire (including AW; RPR 78); dam unraced half-sister to useful 7f 2yo/1m winner Herecomesthesun, out of unraced half-sister to Canadian 1m2f Grade 1 winner Folk Opera; a first ever 2yo runner for her developing stable.
runners.comment: 12,000gns foal; price dropped to 1,800gns as yearling; first ever 2yo runner for her yard

runners.name: Palm Breeze
runners.spotlight: Ten Sovereigns 9,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Spoonful Of Sugar (Swedish 6f) and Chispa (Spanish 5f/French 7f 2yo); dam French 5.5f 2yo winner (RPR 84), closely related to 5.5f 2yo Group 2 winner Family One; yard is a respectable 4-20 with juveniles this season and she demands close market inspection on this first go.
runners.comment: Ten Sovereigns 9,000euros yearling; yard respectable 4-20 with juveniles this season

runners.name: Deja Vu Diva
runners.spotlight: 250-1 for both her starts and they were barely rateable; early days but she's likely one for nurseries.
runners.comment: Has shown nothing in two starts and would be a surprise winner

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Jazz Queen
runners.spotlight: It was much her best effort when runner-up at Chester's May meeting (5.5f, good) on her second start but three other outings don't bear comparison; still early days but she enters handicaps with something to prove.
runners.comment: Best run (5.5f, good) on second start but three other outings don't compare; h'cap debut

runners.name: Quantum Swift
runners.spotlight: Took it up a notch on her handicap debut when making all in Chepstow nursery (6f, good to firm) one week ago; 6lb penalty makes life harder but that was a fairly cosy win and she's likely capable of better; highly respected.
runners.comment: Cosy win on handicap debut (6f, good to firm) one week ago; respected under a penalty
runners.owner: C Munro, Mrs M Gander And Partner

runners.name: Pageant Girl
runners.spotlight: Won Ripon novice (6f, good) on her second start but two heavy defeats have followed, latterly in first-time cheekpieces at Chepstow 18 days ago; new visor needs to help her get back on track on this first crack at a handicap.
runners.comment: Novice winner who hasn't matched that form subsequently; visor goes on for h'cap debut

runners.name: Knock Three Times
runners.spotlight: Looked a shade unfortunate to be claimed late when second on her debut at Nottingham in May and there was no disgrace in not being able to handle the subsequent Albany fourth at Goodwood (also 6f, good) a fortnight later; things didn't go her way in 5f AW novice most recently and she's of interest back at 6f in her first nursery.
runners.comment: Two solid efforts on first two runs; latest can be glossed over; chance on nursery debut

runners.name: Ron's Angel
runners.spotlight: Sent off 33-1 but she was beaten only a neck when runner-up at Bath (5f, good) on her debut in May and went one better on the AW here (6f) one month later; a subsequent stab at Royal Ascot's Albany is easily overlooked and she brings potential to this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Won on AW here (6f) last month; she brings potential to this handicap debut

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap

runners.name: Desert Shadow
runners.spotlight: 0-10 although he did 'win' at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm; demoted for interference) last August; best run since when second to Classic Encounter at Redcar (1m, good to firm; first-time visor) when last seen in May; gets a weights pull and a form case can be made.
runners.comment: Second to Classic Encounter (1m, good to firm; first-time visor) when last seen; form case

runners.name: Huscal
runners.spotlight: Maiden and novice winner who is yet to win a handicap but last time's third of 14 at Newbury (7f, good to firm; fourth has won since) was his best run of this term; far from ruled out off a career-low mark.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but season's best last time; not ruled out off career-low mark

runners.name: Great Chieftain
runners.spotlight: Two 1m good-ground wins last spring include a defeat of Classic Encounter at Newmarket; creditable fifth of 16 at Meydan in January and although his return to these shores didn't go well when tailed off at Newmarket (raced too freely) in April, he's dipped below his last winning mark; considered.
runners.comment: Two 1m wins last spring; tailed off latest but has dipped below last winning mark; chance

runners.name: Classic Encounter
runners.spotlight: Gained a third win when beating Desert Shadow at Redcar (1m, good to firm) in May and he went down narrowly over that C&D (good; third has won since) four weeks ago; leading claims from an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: 3-time winner who went down narrowly four weeks ago; leading claims from unchanged mark

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap

runners.name: Real Gold
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden, with nine of those runs coming on AW; sole turf outing was a long way below her best but she arrives off the back of two solid thirds; makes first start at 5f and it could well suit.
runners.comment: Sole turf outing was long way below best but arrives off two solid thirds; first go at 5f

runners.name: Sunlit Sea
runners.spotlight: 0-9 (eight on AW) but she went very close at Newcastle (5f, AW) off 2lb higher in December; various headgear (including today's blinkers) has been tried over 6f subsequently and she's shaped like a return to 5f will help.
runners.comment: Went close (5f, AW) off 2lb higher in December; 6f followed and return to 5f can suit

runners.name: Mister Moet
runners.spotlight: Turf winner (good to soft) whose two AW wins came here, latterly over 5f off 1lb lower in March; might have needed it when beaten 6l on his return to turf at Doncaster on Thursday.
runners.comment: Turf winner (good to soft) whose two AW wins came here; might have needed latest; chance

runners.name: Shining Guest
runners.spotlight: Has got the better of just two rivals across four starts, including when fifth of six in Yarmouth classified 19 days ago; this is winnable and it's still early days ahead of her handicap debut/first go at 5f.
runners.comment: Beat just two rivals across four starts; still early days on h'cap debut/first go at 5f

races.race_name: Iglu Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Adalida
runners.spotlight: Keen-going sort who proved suited by dropping to 5f when gaining a first win at Lingfield (5f, good) in May; struggled after a slow start at York on his next outing but he bounced back with a close second at Windsor (5f, good to firm) 18 days ago; nudged up 2lb but pulled clear of the third last time and that was behind a major improver who has won won again since; key player.
runners.comment: Unexposed at 5f and he was a close second at Windsor last time; key player

runners.name: London Is Blue
runners.spotlight: Completed a double at Brighton (5.3f, good to firm) last September but he's had only two runs since and has been well held in both of them; been gelded but he has a patchy profile and needs a major revival after another break; withdrawn twice this spring including after getting upset in the stalls here in May.
runners.comment: Dual Brighton winner; been gelded but he needs a major revival after another break

runners.name: Victor Cee
runners.spotlight: Sole win was in a Hamilton maiden (6f, good) last May but he's well handicapped on his best form and wasn't beaten far from a wide draw at Wolverhampton last time; could go well back in trip and he's not ruled out for yard that won this last year.
runners.comment: Record of 1-12 but he could go well back in trip for yard that won this last year

runners.name: Ambishio
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-11 but his won was off 1lb higher at Southwell (5f, AW) in January and he ran well for a long way in a Class 4 handicap at Newmarket (fifth of eighth) 11 days ago; headgear is now added and he could make a bold bid on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark and he could make a bold bid on this drop back in grade; headgear added

races.race_name: Aeropak Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Splash
runners.spotlight: Ended her three-race juvenile campaign with a much-improved second in a Newmarket novice (7f, good) last October; sets the standard on that form but she's struggled in two handicaps this season and needs a major revival back in a maiden.
runners.comment: Sets standard on second at Newmarket last autumn but she's struggled in both runs since

runners.name: Starship Lily
runners.spotlight: 9,000gns yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to four winners including Mojomaker (5f 2yo; RPR 92), Bona Fortuna (6f; 86) and Bella Kopella (5f-7f inc 2yo/AW; 83); dam unplaced 6f/7f (36), half-sister to 1m Group 2-winning dam of 1m/1m2f Group 1 winner Mount Nelson; yard is 17% in maidens this year and she needs watching in the market on debut.
runners.comment: Yard is 17% in maidens this year and she needs watching in the market on debut

runners.name: Spareapenny
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam 5f/6f winner (RPR 83), half-sister to winners Premier League (6f/7f), Laudate Dominum (7.4f-1m) and Volta Do Mar (7f 2yo), out of 7f 2yo winner; yard 3-57 in maidens in recent years and she could be one for later on.
runners.comment: Yard 3-57 in maidens in recent years and she could be one for later on

runners.name: Rogue Exile
runners.spotlight: 27,000euros yearling; first foal; dam German Listed-placed 8.5f/8.7f winner, half-sister to Group-placed 1m4f Flat and smart 1m7f-2m4f hurdle winner Nemean Lion, out of Listed-placed 1m1f winner; interesting newcomer and he needs a close look for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Well-bred newcomer and he needs a close look for in-form yard

runners.name: Sterling Fortune
runners.spotlight: Kameko filly who has shown promise when fifth over C&D (good to firm) and at Southwell (7f, AW) in the last two of her three runs; needs to find more back on turf but it's still early days and she's a half-sister to eight winners; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Has shown promise in her last two runs including over C&D; in the mix back on turf

races.race_name: Otex EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Henley On Thames
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on his debut at Sandown (5f, good) when second of five at Brighton (5.5f, good to firm) three weeks ago, pulling around 6l clear of the third; contender.
runners.comment: Stepped up on his debut when runner-up at Brighton (5.5f) three weeks ago; contender

runners.name: War Gaming
runners.spotlight: £85,000 yearling; shaped encouragingly on his debut at Doncaster (6f, good to firm; 40-1; in cheekpieces) 12 days ago, finishing second of 11 behind one with more experience; likely contender if handling this drop in trip.
runners.comment: Showed plenty on his 6f debut at Doncaster 12 days ago; now drops in trip

runners.name: Kochella
runners.spotlight: Showed up well on her debut at Pontefract (6f, good) in June for Lemos De Souza; failed to beat a rival in the Group 3 Albany at Royal Ascot after a licence switch but should be more competitive returned to maiden company.
runners.comment: Showed up well on her debut (6f) but failed to beat a rival in Group 3 Albany last time

runners.name: Bolt Of Blue
runners.spotlight: 150,000euros yearling, 115,000euros breeze-up purchase; Blue Point colt; second foal; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Indy B (RPR 78); dam runner-up 1m2f in France, half-sister to useful 1m winner Folk Festival, out of Listed-placed 1m1f/1m2f winning sister to 7f 2yo Group 1 winner Parish Hall; one to monitor in the market.
runners.comment: 115,000euros breeze-up purchase; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Indy B; watch the market

runners.name: Horndean
runners.spotlight: Showed plenty on his debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm; 20-1) three weeks ago, keeping on for third after being shuffled back; that form is working out well, with the winner following up and the second also winning since, but this drop to 5f doesn't look an obvious positive (dam's side of the pedigree suggests he may want further).
runners.comment: Showed plenty on his 6f debut in a race that is working out well; drops in trip

runners.name: Anchiano
runners.spotlight: 110,000gns breeze-up buy; sent off favourite on his debut at Beverley (5f, good to firm) two months ago but he raced freely after missing the break and finished well beaten; hood now goes on in a bid to help him settle.
runners.comment: Sent off favourite on debut at Beverley but raced too freely and well beaten; now hooded
runners.owner: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd

races.race_name: 4-Head Handicap

runners.name: Up The Agenda
runners.spotlight: Three of his four wins have been over 6f on the AW but the other came over this C&D (good to soft); latest effort at Southwell (6f, AW) can probably be excused having had a wide trip but others are still preferred; steps back up in trip in a first-time visor.
runners.comment: C&D winner who can probably have his latest effort excused (wide trip); visor goes on

runners.name: Gorgeous Mr George
runners.spotlight: Course specialist who has won over 1m here on his last two starts (good to firm; for Taryn Langley), most recently 19 days ago off a 4lb lower mark than today's; needs things to drop right given the way  he's ridden but he can't be dismissed now returned to 7f.
runners.comment: Course specialist who has won his last two starts here over 1m, 4lb higher than for latest

runners.name: Tryst
runners.spotlight: Sole win from seven starts came in a Wolverhampton novice (8.5f, AW) in October; she ran well when runner-up in a handicap there in April but well beaten over 1m2f on turf in two starts since and now drops to 7f for the first time since her debut; cheekpieces applied.
runners.comment: Struggled in two starts on turf over 1m2f since finishing second at Wolverhampton (8.5f)

runners.name: Sea Suite
runners.spotlight: Doubled his tally when winning over C&D in May off a 1lb lower mark than today's but he was below his best behind Gorgeous Mr George here (1m) four weeks ago; drops back in trip with a bounce back needed.
runners.comment: C&D winner in May but disappointed over 1m here since; bounce back needed

runners.name: Dion Baker
runners.spotlight: Thriving at present, winning five of his last six starts, including one over this C&D; those wins have all been in Class 6 company and he is now up in grade under a 4lb penalty (6lb well in) for last week's Brighton win but there's a chance he could get his own way in front.
runners.comment: Has won five of his last six starts in Class 6 company; 6lb well in under penalty

runners.name: Izzy Fast
runners.spotlight: Won a 6f maiden here in April but she struggled in handicaps on her next two outings; however, she ran well when second of eight over this C&D last week (good to firm) and has solid claims on that form.
runners.comment: Won a 6f maiden here in April and returned to form when second over this C&D a week ago

races.race_name: Doublebase Classified Stakes

runners.name: Spaceage Love Song
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 15 starts came in a classified event at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in February; ran a solid race following a break when runner-up in a handicap here (1m2f) one week ago and he makes the shortlist returned to this longer trip.
runners.comment: Won a classified event over 1m4f at Wolverhampton in February; solid run here latest
runners.owner: M L W Bell Racing Ltd

runners.name: Highland Harvey
runners.spotlight: 15-race maiden but he has finished runner-up in classified company on two occasions, including at Brighton (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; hasn't been with this trainer for long and should go well.
runners.comment: 0-15 but he's finished second on two occasions, including at Brighton last time

runners.name: Suitcase Smith
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has been well beaten in four handicaps this year (1m-1m4f); drops into classified company for the first time but others are preferred.
runners.comment: 0-8 and well beaten in four handicaps this year; drops into a classified for first time

runners.name: Fletcher
runners.spotlight: Posted a fair effort when sixth of 13 in a classified event at Windsor (1m4f, good to soft) last month but he was well beaten at Epsom two weeks ago, taking his record to 0-7; now back into a classified.
runners.comment: Fair effort at Windsor last month but well beaten at Epsom last time; now 0-7

runners.name: Duke Orsino
runners.spotlight: 0-14 and he didn't improve for the step up to 1m4f when fifth of eight at Leicester (good to firm) 20 days ago; drops back down into classified company but others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-14 and didn't improve for the step up to 1m4f at Leicester; others make more appeal

runners.name: Cormorant Rock
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in his first three starts and it was the same story on his handicap debut at Epsom (1m2f, good to firm) last week; this step up in trip needs to bring about some improvement but that's possible as his dam won over 1m5f.
runners.comment: Well beaten on his handicap debut at Epsom over 1m2f last week; dam won over 1m5f

runners.name: Ten Ten Twenty
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose performer who ran well when last seen on the Flat in November, finishing third of 12 at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW); however, he's without a success since winning over hurdles two years ago and was well beaten in that sphere when last seen in May; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Third on AW in November when last seen on the Flat; well beaten over hurdles latest

races.race_name: Bazuka Handicap

runners.name: Startled Lady
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden but she's been placed in three of her last four handicaps including when a 2l third at Newmarket (6f, good to firm; hood removed) last month; that was in a Class 5 event and she's respected on this drop back in grade.
runners.comment: 0-10 but she's been placed in three of her last four runs; respected dropped back in grade

runners.name: Superstorm
runners.spotlight: Runner-up off 4lb higher at Kempton (7f, AW) in April but he's been well held in his last three runs and is now 0-11; cheekpieces are removed and visor is now tried.
runners.comment: 11-race maiden who has been well held in last three runs; headgear switch

runners.name: Dark Side Thunder
runners.spotlight: Eight-time AW winner but he's 1-21 on turf; placed a couple of times this season, including over C&D (good to firm) in April, but he's not easy to predict and was out the back at Doncaster last time; has another switch of headgear and he comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Some placed efforts this season but he flopped last time and is now 1-21 on turf

runners.name: Komodo Rose
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in her qualifying runs but she started her handicap career with a heavy defeat here (7f, soft) last month; may not have handled that testing ground but she has a bit to prove after that and not sure this drop in trip will suit; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Struggled on handicap debut here last month and not sure this drop to 6f will suit

runners.name: Lieutenant Sir
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo who got off the mark when landing a Ffos Las handicap (6f, good) last month; failed to beat a rival in his follow-up bid at Doncaster but he was unable to get a prominent position after a slow start; still has potential and he's a player if he can bounce back.
runners.comment: Flopped at Doncaster last time but he won on his penultimate start and is still unexposed

runners.name: Viking Glory
runners.spotlight: Promise for Adrian Keatley over the winter but he was expensive to follow for that yard; disappointing in three turf handicaps (6f/5f) for James Owen this season and he needs a transformation with visor now tried.
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who has struggled in handicaps for his current yard; visor is now tried

races.race_name: Silver Grecian Handicap (Class 5) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Fashion Legend
runners.spotlight: Another class-dropper who has won four times and has never been this low in the weights; hasn't been in great form but may show more here from a handy draw.
runners.comment: Another class-dropper who has won four times and has never been this low in the weights
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Boniface Ho Ka Kui

runners.name: Our Lucky Glory
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner here at 6f but he stays 1m and has been competitive this year in Class 4s; final run when he finished last needs forgiving but he can run well with cheekpieces removed.
runners.comment: Three-time winner here at 6f but stays 1m and has been competitive this year in Class 4s

runners.name: Telecom Power
runners.spotlight: Has a very underwhelming strike-rate but he's run well on several occasions this year and 1m3f was probably too far the last time; possibilities.
runners.comment: Several good runs in defeat this year and 1m3f was probably too far the last time
runners.owner: Cheung King Shek, Billy Cheung King Shan Et Al

runners.name: Perfecto Moments
runners.spotlight: 0-20 but has run well in spite of some bad draws and was only 2l away when better boxed last time; however, now he's stuck out in 11.
runners.comment: 0-20 but has run well in spite of some bad draws; has another to contend with now

runners.name: Setanta
runners.spotlight: Twice a C&D winner; stuck on a long losing run but has been threatening to put that right; stall 12 isn't ideal but he's one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: C&D wins; stuck on a long losing run but has been threatening to put that right
runners.owner: James Lau Po Man & Alice Woo Wai See

runners.name: Kasa Papa
runners.spotlight: Has been extremely hard to win with in Hong Kong and others are in better form.
runners.comment: Has been extremely hard to win with in Hong Kong and others are in better form

runners.name: Lucky Blessing
runners.spotlight: Made all over C&D in November but hasn't really approached that form since.
runners.comment: Made all over C&D in November but hasn't really approached that form since

runners.name: To Infinity
runners.spotlight: Multiple C&D winner but hasn't been firing for a while now and finished last in a recent trial.
runners.comment: Multiple C&D winner but hasn't been firing for a while and finished last in a recent trial
runners.owner: Chan Wing Chiu & Yildiz Choi Yat Fan

runners.name: Celestial Harmony
runners.spotlight: Interesting on his 2l defeat over this far at Sha Tin in April but nothing like so good in his last two races and was only fifth in a recent trial.
runners.comment: Respected on 2l defeat over this far at Sha Tin in April but nothing like so good since

runners.name: Conrad The Great
runners.spotlight: Drops into a Class 5 but he's 0-11 and his two placed efforts have been on dirt over 6f; no closer than 4l in two attempts at 1m.
runners.comment: Another class-dropper but he's 0-11 and his two placed efforts have been on dirt over 6f
runners.owner: Tam Man Wai, Wilson Tam Man Shu & Dr Tam Po Chor

runners.name: Viva Boss
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden but hasn't been far away stepped up to 1m in his last two races, latterly here last week; should have a chance with Zac Purton riding for the first time.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden but hasn't been far away stepped up to 1m in his last two races

runners.name: Emerging Star
runners.spotlight: This is a drop in grade but there was no joy in trials and he's looked limited on the track; all five starts at 5f/6f, so raised significantly in distance here.
runners.comment: Drops in grade but there was no joy in trials and he's looked limited on the track

races.race_name: Fast Most Furious Handicap (Class 4) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Lean Master
runners.spotlight: Off a much-reduced mark he was a close second over C&D in May and he had an outside stall next time; unfortunately, he's got another now.
runners.comment: Essentially regressive; still capable on his day but opposable from such a wide stall
runners.owner: Cheng Wan Wai, Sheena Cheng Tsz Yan & Selina Cheng Tsz Ching

runners.name: Luck Is Back
runners.spotlight: 4-4 in Brazil but remains winless in Hong Kong despite a sliding mark; all his best form is over further.
runners.comment: 4-4 in Brazil but remains winless in Hong Kong despite a sliding mark

runners.name: Swagger Bro
runners.spotlight: Reserve; has slipped to a tempting mark and nearly off the mark over C&D in March; latest run at Sha Tin was acceptable.
runners.comment: Reserve; nearly won on his last visit here and latest run at Sha Tin was acceptable

runners.name: Free Pony
runners.spotlight: Fourth over 1m in Australia but has looked a sprinter in Hong Kong, showing best form at 6f; however, last three runs were pretty moderate and his usual eyeshield is now left off.
runners.comment: Last three runs were pretty moderate and his usual eyeshield is now left off
runners.owner: Edwin Fong Yick Chung, Edmund Ho Kwok Shing & So Wai Keung

runners.name: Good Luck Babe
runners.spotlight: Reserve; both wins have been at Sha Tin, at 7f and 1m; returned to form with a close fourth last time but that was also at Sha Tin and over further.
runners.comment: Reserve; both wins have been at Sha Tin, at 7f and 1m; has form at 6f but prefers further

runners.name: Loving Vibes
runners.spotlight: Modest 1-26 strike-rate but came second over C&D on last two outings, losing out only by a short head on latter occasion; sports refitted cheekpieces; a possible.
runners.comment: Modest 1-26 strike-rate but came second over C&D on last two outings

runners.name: Jolly Companion
runners.spotlight: Has the form to feature off this low a mark and didn't get the clearest of runs when beaten 3l last time; very effective over C&D but could be better drawn.
runners.comment: Not much luck last time; very effective over C&D but could be better drawn

runners.name: Starry Show
runners.spotlight: Yet to finish better than seventh after ten Hong Kong starts and beaten in a recent trial.
runners.comment: Yet to finish better than seventh after ten Hong Kong starts and beaten in a recent trial

runners.name: Genius Baby
runners.spotlight: Consistent over 6f since his win here in December and every chance again from stall 3 provided he takes to the new visor (replacing cheekpieces).
runners.comment: Consistent over 6f since his win here in December and every chance again from stall 3
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Pang Wai Hak, Frankie Pang Ka Yeung & A Pang Ka Wai

runners.name: Winning Money
runners.spotlight: Defied the widest stall over C&D in January and has continued to run well, including from box 10; last two runs were at 5f and this is more his trip; chance.
runners.comment: Defied the widest stall over C&D in January and has continued to run well

runners.name: Jolly Bonus
runners.spotlight: Has finished out the back in all five trials this year so he's an unlikely debut winner.
runners.comment: Has finished out the back in all five trials this year so he's an unlikely debut winner

runners.name: I Am Back
runners.spotlight: Well behind in two 6f runs on the track and has since gone 0-6 in trials.
runners.comment: Well behind in two 6f runs on the track and has since gone 0-6 in trials

runners.name: Find My Love
runners.spotlight: Not his first C&D win when edging home here two runs ago (April) but never threatened on his return visit off this 5lb higher mark; beat only one home in a recent trial; one or two others appeal more.
runners.comment: Another course win in April but struggled next time off this 5lb higher mark
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Dannis Lee Cheuk Yin

runners.name: Exceptional Santos
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in two starts over 6f at Sha Tin but has finished first (only two ran) and second in subsequent trials.
runners.comment: Poor in two Sha Tin runs but he has shown more in subsequent trials

races.race_name: Turin Warrior Handicap (Class 4) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Noble Pursuit
runners.spotlight: Three course wins; on a lengthy losing run and needs to find something on recent efforts; often held up, so stall 1 could pose problems in that respect.
runners.comment: Often held up, so stall 1 could pose problems in that respect

runners.name: Romantic Laos
runners.spotlight: Regressive 7yo who has not won since December 2024; some good runs this year but below his best of late.
runners.comment: Regressive 7yo; some good runs this year but hasn't been landing a blow of late

runners.name: Northern Beast
runners.spotlight: All four wins over 1m/1m1f here and nearly added another three runs back off 1lb higher; it wasn't a bad latest effort, either.
runners.comment: All four wins over 1m/1m1f here and nearly added another three runs back
runners.owner: Ngai Man, Amy Wang Hong & Doris Ngai Yan Tung

runners.name: Noisy Boy
runners.spotlight: Reserve; not as good as he was and only midfield when favourite 18 days ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Reserve; not as good as he was and only midfield when favourite 18 days ago
runners.owner: Leung Lun Ping & Ricky Leung Ghin Ming

runners.name: Fast Speed
runners.spotlight: Won for the Gosdens in Britain; 0-8 in Hong Kong and very quiet in two runs following an absence.
runners.comment: Won in Britain; 0-8 in Hong Kong and very quiet in two runs following an absence
runners.owner: Howard Tai Wai Yin & Yim Hin Keung

runners.name: Kyrus Treasure
runners.spotlight: One of the favourites when making the most of a drop into Class 5 level over C&D a month ago, collecting by 2l; back up 7lb and returns to a Class 4, but he's not had all that much racing.
runners.comment: Recent Class 5 winner; back up 7lb and in grade, but hasn't had too much racing

runners.name: Ocean Impact
runners.spotlight: 4lb lower than for his win in first-time blinkers here in November; he's gone 0-8 since (cheekpieces back on for last two races) but hasn't been running at all badly.
runners.comment: Has gone 0-8 since November's win here but hasn't been running at all badly

runners.name: Can't Go Wong
runners.spotlight: Reserve; infrequent winner but bang there in his last two races and won't mind returning to 1m1f (from 1m).
runners.comment: Reserve; infrequent winner but bang there in his last two races; back up in trip

runners.name: Firefoot
runners.spotlight: A number of good runs on dirt before proving no match for an improver over this trip on turf at Sha Tin 11 days ago; unlikely to be far away.
runners.comment: A number of good runs on dirt before proving no match for an improver at Sha Tin

runners.name: Storm Runner
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D and at Sha Tin earlier in the year but barely sighted in last three races.
runners.comment: Won over C&D and at Sha Tin earlier in the year but barely sighted in last three races

runners.name: Serangoon
runners.spotlight: Won quite stylishly over 1m1f at Sha Tin in February but below that level since and yet remains 4lb higher.
runners.comment: 4lb higher than for February's win and has been below that level since

runners.name: Volcanic Spark
runners.spotlight: His recent win was over 1m1f on soft at Sha Tin and subsequent defeats at 1m2f; hasn't offered a lot in just two previous visits to Happy Valley.
runners.comment: Recent Sha Tin winner but hasn't offered a lot in just two previous visits to Happy Valley

runners.name: Harmony Galaxy
runners.spotlight: First and eighth in recent trials; all three official wins have come over C&D and he has a kinder draw than on his last visit; he's not handicapped out of it despite top weight.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins and he's not handicapped out of it despite top weight

runners.name: Casa Rochester
runners.spotlight: Has competitive form in stronger races than this and lurks on a dangerous mark; he is a hold-up performer so will need some luck if dropped in from stall 2, but needs respecting.
runners.comment: Has competitive form in stronger races than this and lurks on a dangerous mark

races.race_name: Sweet Orange Handicap (Class 4) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Aestheticism
runners.spotlight: Reserve; regressed this season but was just over 3l away over 1m2f latest after a troubled run, so all hope not yet lost.
runners.comment: Reserve; regressed but was just over 3l away over 1m2f latest after a troubled run

runners.name: Prestige Ricky
runners.spotlight: Now 0-19 in Hong Kong but keeps sliding down the weights and latest effort can be upgraded.
runners.comment: 0-19 in Hong Kong but keeps sliding down the weights and latest effort can be upgraded

runners.name: Light Years Glory
runners.spotlight: Competitive on dirt prior to finishing a close sixth over 7f at Sha Tin on yard debut; that's something to build on, though he's never raced over this far.
runners.comment: Close sixth back on turf at Sha Tin but he's never raced over this far

runners.name: Gazeley
runners.spotlight: A winner in Britain but hasn't got going at all since arriving in Hong Kong; best watched.
runners.comment: A winner in Britain but hasn't got going at all since arriving in Hong Kong; best watched
runners.owner: Billie Lam Chi Fan, Lee Shek Tang Et Al

runners.name: Whowrotethatsong
runners.spotlight: Yet to be placed but only had six races and some were mildly promising, though not the latest.
runners.comment: Only had six races and some were mildly promising, though not the latest

runners.name: Prestige Superior
runners.spotlight: 2-6 when in Australia but a down-the-field outsider on all nine Hong Kong starts; very difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: 2-6 when in Australia but a down-the-field outsider on all nine Hong Kong starts

runners.name: Lucky Together
runners.spotlight: Just one piece of worthwhile form in nine starts in Hong Hong; finished stone-cold last in final run over C&D.
runners.comment: Just one piece of worthwhile form in nine starts in Hong Hong

runners.name: Gorgeous Victory
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but a lightly raced one and has been knocking on the door in recent weeks; nearly got up over 7f at Sha Tin last time and he'll probably stay the mile; fifth in a recent trial under Purton, also aboard for that last official race.
runners.comment: Still a maiden but a lightly raced one and has knocking on the door in recent weeks

runners.name: King Of Selection
runners.spotlight: Reserve; won when trained in New Zealand; best Hong Kong run was his latest when 4l away over 1m at Sha Tin.
runners.comment: Reserve; best Hong Kong run was his latest when 4l away over 1m at Sha Tin

runners.name: Take Action
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come over C&D, the latest by a neck on his penultimate start (drawn high); went up 5lb for that but it was another sound effort from another dodgy draw last time; respected from box 7.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins and another sound effort from another dodgy draw last time

runners.name: Sky Deep
runners.spotlight: On a career-high mark; only worn eyeshields in last two races; recently runner-up over 7f at Sha Tin but didn't appear to see out the 1m back there last time; stamina concerns for now.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 7f before not appearing to stay a mile last time; stamina concerns
runners.owner: Kwan Kin Man, Dora Kwan Man Ting & Bryan Kwan Hon Ming

runners.name: Very Grateful
runners.spotlight: Won in New Zealand but it's proving a struggle in Hong Kong and he was well held in his last three starts; failed to convince on his first run over 1m here last time.
runners.comment: Won in New Zealand but it's proving a struggle in Hong Kong; stamina reservations

runners.name: Shamz
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all ten Hong Kong starts and will do well to turn things around from stall 12.
runners.comment: Unplaced all ten Hong Kong starts and will do well to turn things around from stall 12

runners.name: Ivy League
runners.spotlight: Thoroughly exposed 7yo and beaten fair and square in two races after a lengthy break; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Thoroughly exposed 7yo and beaten fair and square in two races after a lengthy break

races.race_name: Star Shine Handicap (Class 4) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Star Satyr
runners.spotlight: Only win in Hong Kong came off a much higher mark but over a year ago now (7f); however, he's run some ropey races this year and 6f doesn't look his trip.
runners.comment: He's run some ropey races this year and 6f doesn't look his trip

runners.name: Winning Champion
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; has a point to prove after latest disappointing run but has a largely consistent record this year and continues to slip down the weights.
runners.comment: Below par last time but usually consistent and continues to slip down the weights

runners.name: Zeta Hedge
runners.spotlight: Reserve; all downhill since finishing second to Beauty Thunder on his debut here in October; no joy in recent trials.
runners.comment: Reserve; all downhill since finishing second to Beauty Thunder on his debut here in Oct

runners.name: My Triumph
runners.spotlight: Beaten in trials on either side of bringing up the rear on fourth official start at Sha Tin (6f); no real appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten in trials on either side of bringing up the rear on fourth official run at Sha Tin
runners.owner: Ryan Wong Man Yeung & Roland Wong Ka Yeung

runners.name: Phoenix Light
runners.spotlight: No wins here but four at Sha Tin, all over 6f; it's well over two years since he has got his head in front but hasn't been far away in last two races, the penultimate one here.
runners.comment: Hasn't been far away in last two races, the penultimate one here

runners.name: Smiling Champion
runners.spotlight: Safely held in first three races over 6f and suffered same fate upped to 7f last month.
runners.comment: Safely held in first three races over 6f and suffered same fate upped to 7f last month
runners.owner: Ho Tze Man, Martin Lee Ka Shing & Joseph Tse Lap Bun

runners.name: Poet's Reign
runners.spotlight: Down the field in 6f/7f handicaps at Sha Tin since nearly springing a surprise on debut.
runners.comment: Down the field in 6f/7f handicaps at Sha Tin since nearly springing a surprise on debut

runners.name: Cloud Nine
runners.spotlight: Had a couple of blips in his seven races but the second time he's been runner-up when beaten under a length over C&D three weeks ago; that was from stall 9, so he could feature from box 11.
runners.comment: The second time he's been runner-up when beaten under a length over C&D three weeks ago

runners.name: Winalot
runners.spotlight: Took a few goes to win a trial and hard to warm to on official form, especially from stall 12.
runners.comment: Took a few goes to win a trial and hard to warm to on official form

runners.name: Fun N Fun Together
runners.spotlight: Reserve; both wins and best figures have come on dirt; only eighth back on the grass last time when well drawn.
runners.comment: Reserve; both wins and best figures have come on dirt

runners.name: Shotgun
runners.spotlight: Has twice made all on turf this season (6f/7f) and a good run on dirt two runs back, a surface on which he won a recent trial; perhaps a shade high in the weights but has each-way claims from a good draw; last run was too bad to be true.
runners.comment: Perhaps a shade high in the weights but has each-way claims from a good draw

runners.name: Lucky Bid
runners.spotlight: Both runs at Sha Tin; debut was quite promising over this trip and following defeat was over 7f; that was in early May and beaten in two trials since.
runners.comment: Debut over 6f was promising and then ran over 7f; beaten in trials since
runners.owner: Adrian Kwan Chi Keung, Hui Wing Ka & Ho Siu Kong

runners.name: Pejibaye
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when running a rare bad race last time; usually consistent in trials and on the track, on turf and dirt; had previously done well to threaten an unexposed winner when drawn wide over 6f on the dirt; considered from stall 4.
runners.comment: Slowly away when running a rare bad race last time; usually consistent on turf and dirt

runners.name: Beauty Thunder
runners.spotlight: Only Hong Kong win was at 5f but his Irish victory was over an extended 7f; has been in a good run of form over the minimum and looks ready for another crack at 6f; draw not ideal but he's still considered.
runners.comment: In a good run of form over the minimum and looks ready for another crack at 6f

races.race_name: Lucky Patch Handicap (Class 2) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Victor The Winner
runners.spotlight: Group 1 winner in his prime; plummeted down the weights this season but stopped the rot and caused 58-1 surprise over C&D in May (made all), and has since finished fourth off today's mark; Zac Purton keeps the ride; likely contender again.
runners.comment: Surprise winner off much-reduced mark in May and has made the frame off new mark since

runners.name: Magic Control
runners.spotlight: Smart at his best; yet to win this season but on much-reduced mark now and came second twice at Sha Tin last month (6f/5f); cant be ruled out.
runners.comment: Yet to win this season but on much-reduced mark now and came second twice last month

runners.name: Romantic Son
runners.spotlight: Gained all four Hong Kong wins over C&D; needs a career-best performance to overcome current mark but ran on well for fourth over 5f at Sha Tin recently and is now back over his optimum trip.
runners.comment: Still on career-high mark but was fourth over 5f recently and 6f suits him better

runners.name: Turquoise Velocity
runners.spotlight: Progressive 4yo with 4-9 strike-rate, the latest win gained on soft ground at Sha Tin (6f) in May; below form on latest outing, though, and has double-digit draw to contend with today.
runners.comment: Progressive 4yo with 4-9 strike-rate; below form last time, though, and drawn wide

runners.name: Sing Dragon
runners.spotlight: Dual turf winner in Australia but all five local wins have come on dirt; didn't run badly over inadequate 5f last month and has good draw today but still not the percentage call.
runners.comment: Didn't run badly over inadequate 5f last month but all five HK wins were gained on dirt
runners.owner: The Rotary Club Of Gd-HK-MA-GBA Syndicate

runners.name: Crimson Flash
runners.spotlight: Three wins this season (5f-6f); posted sound effort when sixth in 7f Group 3 handicap at Sha Tin last month but finished behind Lucky With You there and remains on the same career-high mark.
runners.comment: Three wins this season (5f-6f); recent efforts suggest he's on a fairly tough mark now

runners.name: Brave Star
runners.spotlight: Six-time C&D winner; sure to be suited by return to this C&D after down-the-field finish over 5f at Sha Tin last month but others look better handicapped.
runners.comment: Has six C&D wins on his CV but others look better handicapped
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Matthew Lam Kin Hong

runners.name: Son Pak Fu
runners.spotlight: Led close home to exploit a reduced mark seven weeks ago, his eighth C&D success; still very well treated on older form but has wide draw and others have more appealing profiles.
runners.comment: Exploited reduced mark here in May, his eighth C&D win, but younger rivals appeal more

runners.name: Bottomuptogether
runners.spotlight: Placed on both starts (once over C&D) since winning over 5f here in April; probably still on a workable mark and ought to make a bold bid under Joao Moreira from stall 1.
runners.comment: Placed both starts since 5f course win in April; fine over 6f; major player from stall 1

runners.name: Young Champion
runners.spotlight: Still 7lb higher than for win at Sha Tin in March but has largely been consistent this year and was denied a clear run before keeping on for third at Sha Tin 11 days ago; each-way claims at least.
runners.comment: Largely consistent this year and was denied clear run when third at Sha Tin recently

runners.name: Lucky With You
runners.spotlight: Not at best this season but outran 73-1 odds when placed off reduced mark in 7f Group 3 handicap at Sha Tin last month; sure to be suited by this drop back to 6f; dangerous if in similar form again.
runners.comment: Not at best this season but placed in recent 7f Group 3 and probably better suited by 6f

races.race_name: Sun Jewellery Handicap (Class 3) (Course C) (Turf)

runners.name: Daryl Flash
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all eight Hong Kong starts; did pretty well to finish sixth from stall 12 over C&D three weeks ago but has the same outside draw again; might be one for another day.
runners.comment: Did well to finish sixth from stall 12 here last month but has same tough draw today

runners.name: Endurance Express
runners.spotlight: Ran well from the front and made promising Hong Kong debut when fourth at Sha Tin in May but weakened into midfield over C&D last month and needs a better effort today.
runners.comment: Made promising HK debut at Sha Tin in May but weakened into midfield here last month

runners.name: Danica's Choice
runners.spotlight: Built upon encouraging stable debut when coming from off the pace for C&D win three weeks ago; back up in grade today but still lightly raced in Hong Kong and might have more to offer for new trainer.
runners.comment: Up in grade after last month's C&D win but still lightly raced in Hong Kong

runners.name: Morgan Success
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a 1m win but has looked out of sorts on all six appearances this term and has left it late in the day to launch his sprinting career.
runners.comment: Badly out of form over 1m this season and has never run in a sprint before

runners.name: Master Of All
runners.spotlight: Gained all five wins over 7f, the latest on seasonal debut in September; recent sprint form has been underwhelming and his favourable draw is not enough to tempt today.
runners.comment: Gained all five wins over 7f; recent sprint form has been underwhelming

runners.name: Ace Champion
runners.spotlight: Reserve; 0-8 in Hong Kong but has twice gone close over C&D and can be excused last month's down-the-field finish (denied clear run); could have a say.
runners.comment: 0-8 in HK but has twice gone close over C&D this year; could have a say

runners.name: Flying Knight
runners.spotlight: Dual Class 4 winner at Sha Tin in recent months (7f/1m) but needs to improve again to overcome this raise grade and has wide draw for return to sprinting.
runners.comment: Dual Class 4 winner in recent months (7f/1m); up in grade and drawn wide for sprint return
runners.owner: Shi Ke Min & Frankie Fang Yuan

runners.name: City Gold Banner
runners.spotlight: Suffered dip in form after 5f Sha Tin win on Hong Kong debut in January but his keeping-on fourth over 6f there was a step back in the right direction; considered each-way.
runners.comment: Last month's Sha Tin fourth was a step back in the right direction; considered each-way

runners.name: King Of Fighters
runners.spotlight: Led close home at Sha Tin (7f) last month, opening his Hong Kong account at the 17th attempt; evidently in good nick but combination of rise in grade and wide draw demands more from him here.
runners.comment: Led close home over 7f recently but moves up in grade and has tough draw today

runners.name: Thunder Kit
runners.spotlight: Opened Hong Kong account at Sha Tin in May and was repeatedly denied a clear run when placed from stall 11 off today's mark there 18 days ago; needs to be taken very seriously from the inside berth here.
runners.comment: Repeatedly denied clear run when placed on latest outing; big player from stall 1
runners.owner: Ian Chan Yau Nam & Cyrus Chan Sing Kit

runners.name: Harmony N Blessed
runners.spotlight: Nearly caused 65-1 shock over 6f at Sha Tin last month and remains on a good mark but this regressive and inconsistent 9yo was soundly beaten over that C&D 11 days ago; can't be relied upon.
runners.comment: Nearly a shock winner a Sha Tin last month but soundly beaten there recently; too risky
runners.owner: Cheung Ming Man, Cheung Ying Ho Et Al

runners.name: The Heir
runners.spotlight: Reserve; resurgent 6yo who won consecutive C&D races in May/June and was close third from stall 11 here on his latest outing; respected if he gets a run.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in May/June and placed from tough draw since; respected

runners.name: Young Emperor
runners.spotlight: Holds no secrets from the handicapper but was beaten under 1l when dead-heat third over C&D three weeks ago and will probably be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Holds no secrets from the handicapper but is in good form; probably on the premises again

runners.name: Flying Wrote
runners.spotlight: Progressive 5yo who has collected three C&D wins this season; looked as good as ever when second here last month but is drawn wider today and may need to find hidden reserves to overcome current mark.
runners.comment: Three C&D wins this season; good second here last month but drawn wider today
runners.owner: Simon Tsang Heung Tung & Shirley Tsang Huang Yang
